Theorem preservation : forall e e' T,
    typing nil e T ->
    step e e' ->

1	Require Export Metalib.Metatheory.

5	Inductive typ : Set :=
6	  | typ_nat : typ
7	  | typ_top : typ
8	  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
9	  | typ_fvar : var -> typ
10	  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
11	  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ
12	  | typ_mu : typ -> typ
13	  | typ_label : var -> typ -> typ
14	  | typ_rcd_nil : typ
15	  | typ_rcd_cons : var -> typ -> typ -> typ
16	.
17	
18	Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.
19	
20	Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.
21	
22	Inductive exp : Set :=
23	  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
24	  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
25	  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
26	  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
27	  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
28	  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
29	  | exp_nat : exp
30	  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
31	  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
32	  | exp_rcd_nil : exp
33	  | exp_rcd_cons : var -> exp -> exp -> exp
34	  | exp_rcd_proj : exp -> var -> exp
35	.
36	
37	Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.
38	
39	Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.
40	
41	Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
42	  match T with
43	  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
44	  | typ_top         => typ_top
45	  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
46	  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
47	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
48	  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
49	  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (open_tt_rec (S K) U T)
50	  | typ_label l T        => typ_label l (open_tt_rec K U T)
51	  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
52	  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
53	  end.
54	
55	Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.
56	
57	Inductive rt_type : typ -> Prop :=
58	  | rt_type_rcd_nil :
59	      rt_type typ_rcd_nil
60	  | rt_type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
61	      rt_type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
62	.
63	
64	Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
65	  | type_top :
66	      type typ_top
67	  | type_nat :
68	      type typ_nat
69	  | type_var : forall X,
70	      type (typ_fvar X)
71	  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
72	      type T1 ->
73	      type T2 ->
74	      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
75	  | type_mu : forall L T,
76	      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->
77	      type (typ_mu T)
78	  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
79	      type T1 ->
80	      (forall X, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 (typ_fvar X))) ->
81	      type (typ_all T1 T2)
82	  | type_label: forall l A,
83	      type A ->
84	      type (typ_label l A)
85	  | type_rcd_nil :
86	      type typ_rcd_nil
87	  | type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
88	      type T1 ->
89	      type T2 ->
90	      rt_type T2 ->
91	      type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2).
92	
93	Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
94	  match T with
95	  | typ_top => typ_top
96	  | typ_nat => typ_nat
97	  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
98	  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
99	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
100	  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
101	  | typ_label l T => typ_label l (subst_tt Z U T)
102	  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
103	  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
104	  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
105	  end.
106	
107	Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
108	  match T with
109	  | typ_top => {}
110	  | typ_nat => {}
111	  | typ_bvar J => {}
112	  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
113	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
114	  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
115	  | typ_mu T => (fv_tt T)
116	  | typ_label l T => (fv_tt T)
117	  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
118	  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => fv_tt T1 \u fv_tt T2
119	  end.
120	
121	Inductive binding : Set :=
122	| bind_sub : typ -> binding
123	| bind_typ : typ -> binding.
124	
125	Definition env := list (atom * binding).
126	
127	Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).
128	
129	Fixpoint Tlookup (i':var) (Tr:typ) : option typ :=
130	  match Tr with
131	  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) =>
132	      if i == i' then Some T1 else Tlookup i' T2
133	  | _ => None
134	  end.
135	
136	Fixpoint collectLabel (T : typ) : atoms :=
137	  match T with
138	  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) => {{i}} \u collectLabel T2
139	  | _ => {}
140	  end.
141	
142	Fixpoint collectLabele (e: exp) : atoms :=
143	  match e with
144	  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) => {{i}} \u collectLabele e2
145	  | _ => {}
146	  end.
147	
148	Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
149	| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
150	| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
151	| WF_var: forall U E (X : atom),
152	      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
153	      WF E (typ_fvar X)
154	| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
155	    WF E A ->
156	    WF E B ->
157	    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
158	| WF_all : forall L E T1 T2,
159	      WF E T1 ->
160	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
161	        WF (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
162	      WF E (typ_all T1 T2)
163	| WF_rec : forall L E A,
164	      (forall X, X \notin L ->
165	                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
166	      (forall X, X \notin L ->
167	                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))) ->
168	      WF E (typ_mu A)
169	| WF_label: forall E A X,
170	    WF E A ->
171	    WF E (typ_label X A)
172	| WF_rcd_nil : forall E,
173	      WF E typ_rcd_nil
174	| WF_rcd_cons : forall E i T1 T2,
175	      WF E T1 ->
176	      WF E T2 ->
177	      rt_type T2 ->
178	      i \notin (collectLabel T2) ->
179	      WF E (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
180	.
181	
182	Fixpoint fl_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
183	  match T with
184	  | typ_top => {}
185	  | typ_nat => {}
186	  | typ_bvar J => {}
187	  | typ_fvar X => {}
188	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) `union` (fl_tt T2)
189	  | typ_mu T => (fl_tt T)
190	  | typ_label X T => {{ X }} `union` fl_tt T
191	  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) \u (fl_tt T2)
192	  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
193	  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => {{i}} \u fl_tt T1 \u fl_tt T2
194	  end.
195	
196	Fixpoint fv_env (E:env) : atoms :=
197	  match E with
198	  | nil => {}
199	  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
200	  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
201	  end.
202	
203	Fixpoint fl_env (E:env) : atoms :=
204	  match E with
205	  | nil => {}
206	  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fl_tt y) \u (fl_env E')
207	  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fl_tt y) \u (fl_env E')
208	  end.
209	
210	Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
211	  | wf_env_empty :
212	      wf_env empty
213	  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
214	      wf_env E ->
215	      WF E T ->
216	      X `notin` dom E ->
217	      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
218	  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
219	      wf_env E ->
220	      WF E T ->
221	      x `notin` dom E ->
222	      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).
223	
224	Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
225	| sa_nat: forall E,
226	    wf_env E ->
227	    sub E typ_nat typ_nat
228	| sa_fvar: forall E X,
229	    wf_env E ->
230	    WF E (typ_fvar X) ->
231	    sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
232	| sa_top : forall E A,
233	    wf_env E ->
234	    WF E A ->
235	    sub E A typ_top
236	| sa_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
237	      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
238	      sub E U T ->
239	      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
240	| sa_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
241	    sub E B1 A1 ->
242	    sub E A2 B2 ->
243	    sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
244	| sa_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
245	    sub E S1 S2 ->
246	    sub E S2 S1 ->
247	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
248	          sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
249	      sub E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2)
250	| sa_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
251	    (forall X,
252	        X \notin L ->
253	        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 X)) ->
254	    (forall X,
255	        X \notin L ->
256	        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A2 X)) ->
257	    (forall X,
258	        X \notin L ->
259	        sub (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 (typ_label X (open_tt A1 X))) (open_tt A2 (typ_label X (open_tt A2 X)))) ->
260	    sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)
261	| sa_label: forall E X A B,
262	    sub E A B ->
263	    sub E (typ_label X A) (typ_label X B)
264	| sa_rcd: forall A1 A2 E,
265	    wf_env E ->
266	    rt_type A1 ->
267	    rt_type A2 ->
268	    collectLabel A2 [<=] collectLabel A1 ->
269	    WF E A1 -> WF E A2 ->
270	    (forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A1 = Some t1 ->  Tlookup i A2 = Some t2 -> sub E t1 t2) ->
271	    sub E A1 A2
272	.
273	
274	Definition subst_tb (Z : atom) (P : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
275	  match b with
276	  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tt Z P T)
277	  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tt Z P T)
278	  end.
279	
280	Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
281	  match e with
282	  | exp_nat => exp_nat
283	  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
284	  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
285	  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
286	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
287	  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
288	  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
289	  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
290	  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
291	  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
292	  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
293	  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_te_rec K U e1) i
294	  end.
295	
296	Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
297	  match e with
298	  | exp_nat => exp_nat
299	  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
300	  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
301	  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
302	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
303	  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (open_ee_rec k f e1)
304	  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
305	  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
306	  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
307	  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
308	  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
309	  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_ee_rec k f e1) i
310	  end.
311	
312	Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.
313	
314	Definition open_ee e1 e2 := open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1.
315	
316	Inductive rt_expr : exp -> Prop :=
317	  | rt_expr_rcd_nil :
318	      rt_expr exp_rcd_nil
319	  | rt_expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
320	      rt_expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
321	.
322	
323	Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
324	  | expr_nat : expr exp_nat
325	  | expr_var : forall x,
326	      expr (exp_fvar x)
327	  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
328	      type T ->
329	      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
330	      expr (exp_abs T e1)
331	  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
332	      expr e1 ->
333	      expr e2 ->
334	      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
335	  | expr_tabs : forall L T e1,
336	      type T ->
337	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
338	      expr (exp_tabs T e1)
339	  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
340	      expr e1 ->
341	      type V ->
342	      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
343	  | expr_unfold: forall T e,
344	     type T ->
345	     expr e ->
346	     expr (exp_unfold T e)
347	  | expr_fold: forall T e,
348	     type T ->
349	     expr e ->
350	     expr (exp_fold T e)
351	  | expr_rcd_nil :
352	     expr exp_rcd_nil
353	  | expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
354	     expr e1 ->
355	     expr e2 ->
356	     rt_expr e2 ->
357	     expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
358	  | expr_rcd_proj : forall i e,
359	     expr e ->
360	     expr (exp_rcd_proj e i)
361	.
362	
363	Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
364	  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).
365	
366	Fixpoint tlookup (i':var) (Er:exp) : option exp :=
367	  match Er with
368	  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) =>
369	      if i == i' then Some e1 else tlookup i' e2
370	  | _ => None
371	  end.
372	
373	Inductive typing : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
374	  | typing_nat: forall G,
375	    wf_env G ->
376	    typing G (exp_nat) (typ_nat)
377	  | typing_var : forall E x T,
378	      wf_env E ->
379	      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
380	      typing E (exp_fvar x) T
381	  | typing_abs : forall L E V e1 T1,
382	      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
383	        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
384	      typing E (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
385	  | typing_app : forall T1 E e1 e2 T2,
386	      typing E e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
387	      typing E e2 T1 ->
388	      typing E (exp_app e1 e2) T2
389	  | typing_tabs : forall L E V e1 T1,
390	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
391	        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
392	      typing E (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
393	  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E e1 T T2,
394	      typing E e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
395	      sub E T T1 ->
396	      typing E (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
397	  | typing_fold : forall G A T e ,
398	      sub G (typ_mu A) T ->
399	      typing G e (open_tt A T)  ->
400	      typing G (exp_fold T e) T
401	  | typing_unfold : forall G A T e,
402	     typing G e A -> sub G A (typ_mu T) ->
403	     typing G (exp_unfold A e)  (open_tt T A)
404	  | typing_sub : forall S E e T,
405	      typing E e S ->
406	      sub E S T ->
407	      typing E e T
408	  | typing_proj : forall G e T i Ti,
409	      typing G e T ->
410	      Tlookup i T = Some Ti ->
411	      typing G (exp_rcd_proj e i) Ti
412	  | typing_rcd_nil : forall G,
413	      wf_env G ->
414	      typing G exp_rcd_nil typ_rcd_nil
415	  | typing_rcd_cons: forall G e1 e2 T1 T2 i,
416	      typing G e1 T1 ->
417	      typing G e2 T2 ->
418	      rt_type T2 ->
419	      rt_expr e2 ->
420	      i \notin (collectLabele e2) ->
421	      typing G (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
422	.
423	
424	Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
425	  | value_abs : forall t1 T,
426	      expr (exp_abs T t1) ->
427	      value (exp_abs T t1)
428	  | value_tabs : forall t1 T,
429	      expr (exp_tabs T t1) ->
430	      value (exp_tabs T t1)
431	  | value_nat:
432	      value exp_nat
433	  | value_fold: forall T e,
434	      type T ->
435	      value e ->
436	      value (exp_fold T e)
437	  | value_rcd_nil:
438	      value exp_rcd_nil
439	 | value_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
440	      value e1 ->
441	      value e2 ->
442	      rt_expr e2 ->
443	      value (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
444	.
445	
446	Inductive step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
447	 | step_beta : forall (e1 e2:exp) T,
448	     expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
449	     value e2 ->
450	     step (exp_app  (exp_abs T e1) e2)  (open_ee e1 e2)
451	 | step_app1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
452	     expr e2 ->
453	     step e1 e1' ->
454	     step (exp_app e1 e2) (exp_app e1' e2)
455	 | step_app2 : forall v1 e2 e2',
456	     value v1 ->
457	     step e2 e2' ->
458	     step (exp_app v1 e2) (exp_app v1 e2')
459	 | step_tapp : forall e1 e1' V,
460	      type V ->
461	      step e1 e1' ->
462	      step (exp_tapp e1 V) (exp_tapp e1' V)
463	 | step_tabs : forall T1 e1 T2,
464	      expr (exp_tabs T1 e1) ->
465	      type T2 ->
466	      step (exp_tapp (exp_tabs T1 e1) T2) (open_te e1 T2)
467	 | step_fld: forall S T v,
468	     value v ->
469	     type T ->
470	     type S ->
471	     step (exp_unfold S (exp_fold T v)) v
472	 | step_fold: forall e e' T,
473	     step e e' ->
474	     type T ->
475	     step (exp_fold T e) (exp_fold T e')
476	 | step_unfold: forall e e' T,
477	     step e e' ->
478	     type T ->
479	     step (exp_unfold T e) (exp_unfold T e')
480	 | step_projrcd: forall e i vi ,
481	     value e ->
482	     tlookup i e = Some vi->
483	     step (exp_rcd_proj e i) vi
484	 | step_proj: forall e1 e2 i,
485	     step e1 e2 ->
486	     step (exp_rcd_proj e1 i) (exp_rcd_proj e2 i)
487	 | step_rcd_head: forall e1 e2 e i,
488	     step e1 e2 ->
489	     step (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e) (exp_rcd_cons i e2 e)
490	 | step_rcd_cons: forall v1 e1 e2 i,
491	     value v1 ->
492	     step e1 e2 ->
493	     step (exp_rcd_cons i v1 e1) (exp_rcd_cons i v1 e2)
494	.
495	
496	Fixpoint fv_te (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
497	  match e with
498	  | exp_nat => {}
499	  | exp_bvar i => {}
500	  | exp_fvar x => {}
501	  | exp_abs V e1  => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
502	  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
503	  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
504	  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
505	  | exp_fold V e => fv_tt V \u fv_te e
506	  | exp_unfold V e => fv_tt V \u fv_te e
507	  | exp_rcd_nil => {}
508	  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
509	  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => (fv_te e1)
510	  end.
511	
512	Fixpoint fv_ee (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
513	  match e with
514	  | exp_nat => {}
515	  | exp_bvar i => {}
516	  | exp_fvar x => {{ x }}
517	  | exp_abs V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
518	  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
519	  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
520	  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_ee e1)
521	  | exp_fold V e => fv_ee e
522	  | exp_unfold V e => fv_ee e
523	  | exp_rcd_nil => {}
524	  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
525	  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => (fv_ee e1)
526	  end.
527	
528	Fixpoint subst_te (Z : atom) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
529	  match e with
530	  | exp_nat => exp_nat
531	  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
532	  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
533	  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (subst_tt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)
534	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
535	  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (subst_tt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)
536	  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_tt Z U V)
537	  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold (subst_tt Z U V) (subst_te Z U e)
538	  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold (subst_tt Z U V) (subst_te Z U e)
539	  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
540	  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
541	  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (subst_te Z U e1) i
542	  end.
543	
544	Fixpoint subst_ee (z : atom) (u : exp) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
545	  match e with
546	  | exp_nat => exp_nat
547	  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
548	  | exp_fvar x => if x == z then u else e
549	  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (subst_ee z u e1)
550	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
551	  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (subst_ee z u e1)
552	  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_ee z u e1) V
553	  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (subst_ee z u e)
554	  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (subst_ee z u e)
555	  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
556	  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
557	  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (subst_ee z u e1) i
558	  end.
559	
560	Inductive Mode := Pos | Neg.
561	
562	Definition choose (m : Mode)  (C : typ) (D : typ) :=
563	  match m with
564	  | Pos => C
565	  | Neg => D
566	  end.
567	
568	Definition flip (m : Mode) : Mode :=
569	  match m with
570	  | Pos => Neg
571	  | Neg => Pos
572	  end.

574	Definition equiv E A B := sub E A B /\ sub E B A.

Require Export Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_nat : typ
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : var -> typ
  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_mu : typ -> typ
  | typ_label : var -> typ -> typ
  | typ_rcd_nil : typ
  | typ_rcd_cons : var -> typ -> typ -> typ
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_nat : exp
  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_nil : exp
  | exp_rcd_cons : var -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_proj : exp -> var -> exp
.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
  | typ_top         => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (open_tt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_label l T        => typ_label l (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Inductive rt_type : typ -> Prop :=
  | rt_type_rcd_nil :
      rt_type typ_rcd_nil
  | rt_type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      rt_type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_nat :
      type typ_nat
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_mu : forall L T,
      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_mu T)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_label: forall l A,
      type A ->
      type (typ_label l A)
  | type_rcd_nil :
      type typ_rcd_nil
  | type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2).

Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_label l T => typ_label l (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_label l T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => fv_tt T1 \u fv_tt T2
  end.

Inductive binding : Set :=
| bind_sub : typ -> binding
| bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Fixpoint Tlookup (i':var) (Tr:typ) : option typ :=
  match Tr with
  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) =>
      if i == i' then Some T1 else Tlookup i' T2
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint collectLabel (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) => {{i}} \u collectLabel T2
  | _ => {}
  end.

Fixpoint collectLabele (e: exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) => {{i}} \u collectLabele e2
  | _ => {}
  end.

Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_var: forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      WF E (typ_all T1 T2)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A)
| WF_label: forall E A X,
    WF E A ->
    WF E (typ_label X A)
| WF_rcd_nil : forall E,
      WF E typ_rcd_nil
| WF_rcd_cons : forall E i T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      WF E T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabel T2) ->
      WF E (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Fixpoint fl_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) `union` (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fl_tt T)
  | typ_label X T => {{ X }} `union` fl_tt T
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) \u (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => {{i}} \u fl_tt T1 \u fl_tt T2
  end.

Fixpoint fv_env (E:env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
  end.

Fixpoint fl_env (E:env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fl_tt y) \u (fl_env E')
  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fl_tt y) \u (fl_env E')
  end.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WF E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WF E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sa_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub E typ_nat typ_nat
| sa_fvar: forall E X,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E (typ_fvar X) ->
    sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sa_top : forall E A,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E A ->
    sub E A typ_top
| sa_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
| sa_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub E B1 A1 ->
    sub E A2 B2 ->
    sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sa_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
    sub E S1 S2 ->
    sub E S2 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2)
| sa_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A2 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        sub (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 (typ_label X (open_tt A1 X))) (open_tt A2 (typ_label X (open_tt A2 X)))) ->
    sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)
| sa_label: forall E X A B,
    sub E A B ->
    sub E (typ_label X A) (typ_label X B)
| sa_rcd: forall A1 A2 E,
    wf_env E ->
    rt_type A1 ->
    rt_type A2 ->
    collectLabel A2 [<=] collectLabel A1 ->
    WF E A1 -> WF E A2 ->
    (forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A1 = Some t1 ->  Tlookup i A2 = Some t2 -> sub E t1 t2) ->
    sub E A1 A2
.

Definition subst_tb (Z : atom) (P : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tt Z P T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tt Z P T)
  end.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_te_rec K U e1) i
  end.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_ee_rec k f e1) i
  end.

Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.

Definition open_ee e1 e2 := open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1.

Inductive rt_expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | rt_expr_rcd_nil :
      rt_expr exp_rcd_nil
  | rt_expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
      rt_expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | expr_nat : expr exp_nat
  | expr_var : forall x,
      expr (exp_fvar x)
  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1)
  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
  | expr_tabs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_tabs T e1)
  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
      expr e1 ->
      type V ->
      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
  | expr_unfold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_unfold T e)
  | expr_fold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_fold T e)
  | expr_rcd_nil :
     expr exp_rcd_nil
  | expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
     expr e1 ->
     expr e2 ->
     rt_expr e2 ->
     expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
  | expr_rcd_proj : forall i e,
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_rcd_proj e i)
.

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Fixpoint tlookup (i':var) (Er:exp) : option exp :=
  match Er with
  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) =>
      if i == i' then Some e1 else tlookup i' e2
  | _ => None
  end.

Inductive typing : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_nat: forall G,
    wf_env G ->
    typing G (exp_nat) (typ_nat)
  | typing_var : forall E x T,
      wf_env E ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E e1 e2 T2,
      typing E e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E e2 T1 ->
      typing E (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E e1 T T2,
      typing E e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_fold : forall G A T e ,
      sub G (typ_mu A) T ->
      typing G e (open_tt A T)  ->
      typing G (exp_fold T e) T
  | typing_unfold : forall G A T e,
     typing G e A -> sub G A (typ_mu T) ->
     typing G (exp_unfold A e)  (open_tt T A)
  | typing_sub : forall S E e T,
      typing E e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E e T
  | typing_proj : forall G e T i Ti,
      typing G e T ->
      Tlookup i T = Some Ti ->
      typing G (exp_rcd_proj e i) Ti
  | typing_rcd_nil : forall G,
      wf_env G ->
      typing G exp_rcd_nil typ_rcd_nil
  | typing_rcd_cons: forall G e1 e2 T1 T2 i,
      typing G e1 T1 ->
      typing G e2 T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      rt_expr e2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabele e2) ->
      typing G (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall t1 T,
      expr (exp_abs T t1) ->
      value (exp_abs T t1)
  | value_tabs : forall t1 T,
      expr (exp_tabs T t1) ->
      value (exp_tabs T t1)
  | value_nat:
      value exp_nat
  | value_fold: forall T e,
      type T ->
      value e ->
      value (exp_fold T e)
  | value_rcd_nil:
      value exp_rcd_nil
 | value_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
      value e1 ->
      value e2 ->
      rt_expr e2 ->
      value (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
.

Inductive step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | step_beta : forall (e1 e2:exp) T,
     expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
     value e2 ->
     step (exp_app  (exp_abs T e1) e2)  (open_ee e1 e2)
 | step_app1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     expr e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->

      expr (exp_tabs T1 e1) ->
      type T2 ->
      step (exp_tapp (exp_tabs T1 e1) T2) (open_te e1 T2)

     step e1 e2 ->

     step e1 e2 ->

     value v1 ->
     step e1 e2 ->
     step (exp_rcd_cons i v1 e1) (exp_rcd_cons i v1 e2)

Fixpoint fv_te (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_bvar i => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {}
  | exp_abs V e1  => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_fold V e => fv_tt V \u fv_te e
  | exp_unfold V e => fv_tt V \u fv_te e
  | exp_rcd_nil => {}
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => (fv_te e1)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_ee (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_bvar i => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {{ x }}
  | exp_abs V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_fold V e => fv_ee e
  | exp_unfold V e => fv_ee e
  | exp_rcd_nil => {}
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => (fv_ee e1)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_te (Z : atom) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (subst_tt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (subst_tt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_tt Z U V)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold (subst_tt Z U V) (subst_te Z U e)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold (subst_tt Z U V) (subst_te Z U e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (subst_te Z U e1) i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_ee (z : atom) (u : exp) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => if x == z then u else e
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_ee z u e1) V
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (subst_ee z u e)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (subst_ee z u e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (subst_ee z u e1) i
  end.

Inductive Mode := Pos | Neg.

Definition choose (m : Mode)  (C : typ) (D : typ) :=
  match m with
  | Pos => C
  | Neg => D
  end.

Definition flip (m : Mode) : Mode :=
  match m with
  | Pos => Neg
  | Neg => Pos
  end.

Definition equiv E A B := sub E A B /\ sub E B A.

Require Import Rules.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Dev.Prelude.

Scheme sub_dep := Induction for sub Sort Prop.

Inductive sderiv : Type :=
| SD : forall (E : env) (A B : typ), sub E A B -> sderiv.

Arguments SD E A B _.

Inductive sub_subterm : sderiv -> sderiv -> Prop :=
| ss_trans_tvar : forall U E T X (Hb : binds X (bind_sub U) E) (Hsub : sub E U T),
    sub_subterm (SD E U T Hsub) (SD E (typ_fvar X) T (sa_trans_tvar U E T X Hb Hsub))
| ss_arrow_1 : forall E A1 A2 B1 B2 (h1 : sub E B1 A1) (h2 : sub E A2 B2),
    sub_subterm (SD E B1 A1 h1) (SD E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2) (sa_arrow E A1 A2 B1 B2 h1 h2))
| ss_arrow_2 : forall E A1 A2 B1 B2 (h1 : sub E B1 A1) (h2 : sub E A2 B2),
    sub_subterm (SD E A2 B2 h2) (SD E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2) (sa_arrow E A1 A2 B1 B2 h1 h2))
| ss_all_1 : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2 (h12 : sub E S1 S2) (h21 : sub E S2 S1)
    (hbody : forall X, X \notin L -> sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)),
    sub_subterm (SD E S1 S2 h12) (SD E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) (sa_all L E S1 S2 T1 T2 h12 h21 hbody))
| ss_all_2 : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2 (h12 : sub E S1 S2) (h21 : sub E S2 S1)
    (hbody : forall X, X \notin L -> sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)),
    sub_subterm (SD E S2 S1 h21) (SD E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) (sa_all L E S1 S2 T1 T2 h12 h21 hbody))
| ss_all_body : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2 (h12 : sub E S1 S2) (h21 : sub E S2 S1)
    (hbody : forall X, X \notin L -> sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)) X HX,
    sub_subterm (SD (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X) (hbody X HX))
                (SD E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) (sa_all L E S1 S2 T1 T2 h12 h21 hbody))
| ss_rec_body : forall L A1 A2 E
    (w1 : forall X, X \notin L -> WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 X))
    (w2 : forall X, X \notin L -> WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A2 X))
    (hbody : forall X, X \notin L -> sub (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)
        (open_tt A1 (typ_label X (open_tt A1 X))) (open_tt A2 (typ_label X (open_tt A2 X)))) X HX,
    sub_subterm (SD (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)
                    (open_tt A1 (typ_label X (open_tt A1 X)))
                    (open_tt A2 (typ_label X (open_tt A2 X))) (hbody X HX))
                (SD E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) (sa_rec L A1 A2 E w1 w2 hbody))
| ss_label : forall E X A B (h : sub E A B),
    sub_subterm (SD E A B h) (SD E (typ_label X A) (typ_label X B) (sa_label E X A B h))
| ss_rcd : forall A1 A2 E (Hwe : wf_env E) (Hrt1 : rt_type A1) (Hrt2 : rt_type A2)
    (Hcl : collectLabel A2 [<=] collectLabel A1) (Hwf1 : WF E A1) (Hwf2 : WF E A2)
    (hpt : forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A1 = Some t1 -> Tlookup i A2 = Some t2 -> sub E t1 t2)
    i t1 t2 (H1 : Tlookup i A1 = Some t1) (H2 : Tlookup i A2 = Some t2),
    sub_subterm (SD E t1 t2 (hpt i t1 t2 H1 H2))
                (SD E A1 A2 (sa_rcd A1 A2 E Hwe Hrt1 Hrt2 Hcl Hwf1 Hwf2 hpt)).

Lemma sub_subterm_wf : forall d : sderiv, Acc sub_subterm d.

  - (* all1 *) assumption.
  - (* all2 *) assumption.
  - (* all body *) apply H3.
  - (* rec body *) apply H0.
  - (* label *) assumption.
  - (* rcd *) apply H0.

Require Import Rules.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Dev.Prelude.

Fixpoint lc_at (k : nat) (e : exp) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => True
  | exp_bvar i => i < k
  | exp_fvar _ => True
  | exp_abs _ e1 => lc_at (S k) e1
  | exp_app e1 e2 => lc_at k e1 /\ lc_at k e2
  | exp_tabs _ e1 => lc_at (S k) e1
  | exp_tapp e1 _ => lc_at k e1
  | exp_unfold _ e1 => lc_at k e1
  | exp_fold _ e1 => lc_at k e1
  | exp_rcd_nil => True
  | exp_rcd_cons _ e1 e2 => lc_at k e1 /\ lc_at k e2
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 _ => lc_at k e1
  end.

Lemma lc_at_mono : forall k e, lc_at k e -> lc_at (S k) e.
Proof.
  intros k e. revert k. induction e; simpl; intros k H; auto.
  - lia.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_at_ge : forall k e, lc_at 0 e -> lc_at k e.
Proof.
  intros k. induction k; intros e H.
  - exact H.
  - apply lc_at_mono. apply IHk. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_ee_id : forall j f e, lc_at j e -> open_ee_rec j f e = e.
Proof.
  intros j f e. revert j. induction e; simpl; intros j H; auto.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (j === n); [exfalso; lia|reflexivity].
  - (* app *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite IHe1, IHe2; auto.
  - (* tabs *) rewrite IHe; auto.
  - (* rcd_cons *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite IHe1, IHe2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_ee_inv : forall j f e, lc_at j (open_ee_rec j f e) -> lc_at (S j) e.
Proof.
  intros j f e. revert j. induction e; simpl; intros j H; auto.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (j === n); [lia|lia].
  - (* app *) destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply IHe1 with (j:=j)|apply IHe2 with (j:=j)]; auto.
  - (* tabs *) apply IHe; auto.
  - (* rcd_cons *) destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply IHe1 with (j:=j)|apply IHe2 with (j:=j)]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_te : forall j X e k, lc_at k (open_te_rec j X e) -> lc_at k e.
Proof.
  intros j X e. revert j. induction e; simpl; intros j k H; auto.
  - (* app *) destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply IHe1 with (j:=j)|apply IHe2 with (j:=j)]; auto.
  - (* tabs *) apply IHe; auto.
  - (* rcd_cons *) destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply IHe1 with (j:=j)|apply IHe2 with (j:=j)]; auto.
Qed.
EOF

Require Import Rules.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import Dev.Prelude.
Fixpoint lc_at (k : nat) (e : exp) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => True | exp_bvar i => i < k | exp_fvar _ => True
  | exp_abs _ e1 => lc_at (S k) e1
  | exp_app e1 e2 => lc_at k e1 /\ lc_at k e2
  | exp_tabs _ e1 => lc_at (S k) e1
  | exp_tapp e1 _ => lc_at k e1
  | exp_unfold _ e1 => lc_at k e1
  | exp_fold _ e1 => lc_at k e1
  | exp_rcd_nil => True
  | exp_rcd_cons _ e1 e2 => lc_at k e1 /\ lc_at k e2
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 _ => lc_at k e1
  end.
Lemma lc_at_mono : forall k e, lc_at k e -> lc_at (S k) e.
Proof.
  intros k e. revert k. induction e; simpl; intros k H; try tauto.
  - lia.
  - apply IHe. exact H.
  - simpl in H; destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [apply IHe1 with (k:=k)|apply IHe2 with (k:=k)]; assumption.
  - apply IHe. exact H.
  - apply IHe. exact H.
  - apply IHe. exact H.
  - apply IHe. exact H.
  - simpl in H; destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [apply IHe1 with (k:=k)|apply IHe2 with (k:=k)]; assumption.
  - apply IHe. exact H.
Qed.
Lemma lc_at_ge : forall k e, lc_at 0 e -> lc_at k e.
Proof.
  intros k. induction k; intros e H.
  - exact H.
  - apply lc_at_mono. apply IHk. exact H.
Qed.
Lemma lc_open_ee_id : forall j f e, lc_at j e -> open_ee_rec j f e = e.
Proof.
  intros j f e. revert j. induction e; simpl; intros j H; auto.
  - remember (j == n) as b eqn:E. destruct b as [E1|E1]; simpl in *.
    + exfalso. lia.
    + reflexivity.
  - apply f_equal. apply IHe with (j:=S j). exact H.
  - simpl in H; destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHe1 j H1), (IHe2 j H2). reflexivity.
  - apply f_equal. apply IHe with (j:=S j). exact H.
  - apply f_equal. apply IHe with (j:=j). exact H.
  - apply f_equal. apply IHe with (j:=j). exact H.
  - apply f_equal. apply IHe with (j:=j). exact H.
  - simpl in H; destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHe1 j H1), (IHe2 j H2). reflexivity.
  - apply f_equal. apply IHe with (j:=j). exact H.
Qed.
Lemma lc_open_ee_inv : forall j f e, lc_at j (open_ee_rec j f e) -> lc_at (S j) e.
Proof.
  intros j f e. revert j. induction e; simpl; intros j H; auto.
  - remember (j == n) as b eqn:E. destruct b as [E1|E1]; simpl in *; lia.
  - apply IHe with (j:=S j). exact H.
  - simpl in H; destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply IHe1 with (j:=j)|apply IHe2 with (j:=j)]; assumption.
  - apply IHe with (j:=S j). exact H.
  - apply IHe with (j:=j). exact H.
  - apply IHe with (j:=j). exact H.
  - apply IHe with (j:=j). exact H.
  - simpl in H; destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply IHe1 with (j:=j)|apply IHe2 with (j:=j)]; assumption.
  - apply IHe with (j:=j). exact H.
Qed.
Lemma lc_open_te : forall j X e k, lc_at k (open_te_rec j X e) -> lc_at k e.
Proof.

  - simpl in H; destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply IHe1 with (j:=j)|apply IHe2 with (j:=j)]; assumption.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_te_rec K U e1) i
  end.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_ee_rec k f e1) i
  end.

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=

    wf_env E ->

    rt_type A2 ->
    collectLabel A2 [<=] collectLabel A1 ->

Definition subst_tb (Z : atom) (P : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tt Z P T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tt Z P T)

  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_te_rec K U e1) i

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WF E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WF E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_var: forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      WF E (typ_all T1 T2)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A)
| WF_label: forall E A X,
    WF E A ->
    WF E (typ_label X A)
| WF_rcd_nil : forall E,
      WF E typ_rcd_nil
| WF_rcd_cons : forall E i T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      WF E T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabel T2) ->
      WF E (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Fixpoint fl_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) `union` (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fl_tt T)
  | typ_label X T => {{ X }} `union` fl_tt T
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) \u (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => {{i}} \u fl_tt T1 \u fl_tt T2
  end.

Fixpoint fv_env (E:env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
  end.

Fixpoint fl_env (E:env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fl_tt y) \u (fl_env E')
  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fl_tt y) \u (fl_env E')
  end.

  | rt_type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      rt_type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_nat :
      type typ_nat
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_mu : forall L T,
      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->

  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 (typ_fvar X))) ->

  | type_label: forall l A,

  | type_rcd_nil :

  | type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2).

Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat

- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.

Lemma subst_tt_fvar_eq : forall X U, subst_tt X U (typ_fvar X) = U.
Proof. intros. simpl. destruct (X == X); [reflexivity|contradiction]. Qed.

Lemma subst_tt_fvar_neq : forall X Y U, X <> Y -> subst_tt X U (typ_fvar Y) = typ_fvar Y.
Proof. intros. simpl. destruct (Y == X) as [E|E]; [exfalso; apply H; symmetry; exact E | reflexivity]. Qed.

Lemma subst_tt_open_tt_rec_diff : forall X U K Y T,
  X <> Y -> X \notin fv_tt T ->
  subst_tt X U (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) T) = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) (subst_tt X U T).
Proof.
  intros X U K Y T Hneq Hfv.
  generalize dependent K.
  induction T; intros K; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (K === n); [ apply subst_tt_fvar_neq; auto | reflexivity ].
  - (* fvar a: Hfv : a \notin {{X}}? actually fv_tt (fvar a) = {{a}}; H : X \notin {{a}} *)
    apply notin_singleton_1 in Hfv. simpl. destruct (a == X) as [E|E].
    + exfalso. exact (Hfv E).
    + reflexivity.
  - (* arrow *) apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as H2.
    rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
  - (* all *) apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as H2.
    rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
  - (* mu *) rewrite IHT; auto.
  - (* label *) rewrite IHT; auto.
  - (* rcd_nil *) reflexivity.
  - (* rcd_cons *) apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as H2.
    rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tt_open_tt_rec_same : forall X U K T,
  X \notin fv_tt T ->
  subst_tt X U (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T) = open_tt_rec K U T.
Proof.
  intros X U K T Hfv.
  generalize dependent K.
  induction T; intros K; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. destruct (X == X) as [E|E]; [reflexivity|contradiction].
    + reflexivity.
  - (* fvar a *) apply notin_singleton_1 in Hfv. simpl. destruct (a == X) as [E|E].
    + exfalso. exact (Hfv E).
    + reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as H2.
    rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
  - apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as H2.
    rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT; auto.
  - rewrite IHT; auto.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as H2.
    rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env facts *)
Lemma wf_env_sub_inv : forall E X T,
  wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E) -> wf_env E /\ WF E T /\ X \notin dom E.
Proof. intros E X T H. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_typ_inv : forall E x T,
  wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E) -> wf_env E /\ WF E T /\ x \notin dom E.
Proof. intros E x T H. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma typing_wf_env : forall E e T, typing E e T -> wf_env E.
Proof.
  intros E e T H. induction H.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
  - destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. pose proof (H0 x Hx) as Hw. apply wf_env_typ_inv in Hw. tauto.
  - assumption.
  - destruct (atom_fresh L) as [X HX]. pose proof (H0 X HX) as Hw. apply wf_env_sub_inv in Hw. tauto.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof. intros E H. induction H; constructor; assumption. Qed.

Lemma binds_sub_cons_incl : forall (X : atom) (T : typ) E E',
  (forall Z V, binds Z (bind_sub V) E -> exists V', binds Z (bind_sub V') E') ->
  forall Z V, binds Z (bind_sub V) (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E) ->
    exists V', binds Z (bind_sub V') (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E').
Proof.
  intros X T E E' Hinc Z V Hb.
  apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[Heq Hveq]|Hb].
  - subst. exists T. simpl. left. reflexivity.
  - destruct (Hinc Z V Hb) as [V' HV']. exists V'. simpl. right. exact HV'.
Qed.

Lemma WF_binds_irrel : forall E T, WF E T ->
  forall E', (forall Z V, binds Z (bind_sub V) E -> exists V', binds Z (bind_sub V') E') -> WF E' T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros E' Hinc.
  - apply WF_top.
  - apply WF_nat.
  - destruct (Hinc X U H) as [U' HU']. apply WF_var with U'; auto.
  - apply WF_arrow; auto.
  - apply WF_all with (L := L).
    + auto.
    + intros X HX. apply H1; auto. apply binds_sub_cons_incl; auto.
  - apply WF_rec with (L := L).
    + intros X HX. apply H0; auto. apply binds_sub_cons_incl; auto.
    + intros X HX. apply H2; auto. apply binds_sub_cons_incl; auto.
  - apply WF_label; auto.
  - apply WF_rcd_nil.
  - apply WF_rcd_cons; auto.
Qed.


Lemma binds_sub_head_change : forall (X : atom) (T1 T2 : typ) E Z V,
  binds Z (bind_sub V) (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) ->
  exists V', binds Z (bind_sub V') (X ~ bind_sub T2 ++ E).
Proof.
  intros X T1 T2 E Z V Hb.
  apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[Heq Hveq]|Hb].
  - subst. exists T2. simpl. left. reflexivity.
  - exists V. simpl. right. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma sub_wf : forall E A B, sub E A B -> WF E A /\ WF E B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction H.
  - split; apply WF_nat.
  - split; assumption.
  - split; [assumption|apply WF_top].
  - split.
    + apply WF_var with U; tauto.
    + tauto.
  - split; apply WF_arrow; tauto.
  - split.
    + apply WF_all with (L := L).
      * tauto.
      * intros X HX.
        eapply WF_binds_irrel.
        -- destruct (H2 X HX) as [Hl _]. exact Hl.
        -- intros Z V' Hb. eapply binds_sub_head_change; eauto.
    + apply WF_all with (L := L).
      * tauto.
      * intros X HX.
        destruct (H2 X HX) as [_ Hr]. exact Hr.
  - split.
    + apply WF_rec with (L := L).
      * exact H.
      * intros X HX.
        destruct (H2 X HX) as [Hl _]. exact Hl.
    + apply WF_rec with (L := L).
      * exact H0.
      * intros X HX.
        destruct (H2 X HX) as [_ Hr]. exact Hr.
  - split; apply WF_label; tauto.
  - split; assumption.
Qed.


(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 4: reflexivity and weakening of subtyping               *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma sub_refl_strong : forall E T, WF E T -> wf_env E ->
  sub E T T /\ (rt_type T -> forall l t, Tlookup l T = Some t -> sub E t t).
Proof.
  intros E T Hwf. induction Hwf as
    [ E
    | E
    | U E X b
    | E A B w0 IH0 w1 IH1
    | L E T1 T2 w0 IH0 wbody IHbody
    | L E A w0 IH0 w1 IH1
    | E A X w0 IH0
    | E
    | E i T1 T2 w0 IH0 w1 IH1 r n ];
    intros Hwe.
  - split.
    + apply sa_top; [assumption|apply WF_top].
    + intros Hrt; inversion Hrt.
  - split.
    + apply sa_nat; assumption.
    + intros Hrt; inversion Hrt.
  - split.
    + apply sa_fvar; [assumption|apply WF_var with U; assumption].
    + intros Hrt; inversion Hrt.
  - split.
    + apply sa_arrow; [apply (proj1 (IH0 Hwe)) | apply (proj1 (IH1 Hwe))].
    + intros Hrt; inversion Hrt.

Lemma sub_arrow_inv : forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
  sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2) -> sub E B1 A1 /\ sub E A2 B2.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst; auto;
  try (exfalso; match goal with
       | Hr : rt_type (typ_arrow _ _) |- _ => inversion Hr
       | He : typ_arrow _ _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate He
       | He : typ_arrow _ _ = typ_fvar _ |- _ => discriminate He
       end).
Qed.

    (forall X, X \notin L -> sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)).
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst; eauto;
  try (exfalso; match goal with
       | Hr : rt_type (typ_all _ _) |- _ => inversion Hr
       | He : typ_all _ _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate He

Qed.

  forall Z c, binds Z c (X ~ b ++ E) -> binds Z c (X ~ b ++ E').
Proof.
  intros X b E E' Hinc Z c Hb.
  apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[Heq Hbeq]|Ht].
  - subst Z. subst c. simpl. left. reflexivity.
  - simpl. right. apply Hinc. exact Ht.
Qed.

  forall E', wf_env E' ->
    (forall Z b, binds Z b E -> binds Z b E') ->
    typing E' e T.
Proof.
  intros E e T H. induction H; intros E' Hwe Hinc.
  - apply typing_nat; assumption.

  - (* abs *)
    apply typing_abs with (L := L \u dom E').

    assert (HXL : x \notin L) by (exact (notin_union_1 x L (dom E') Hx)).
    assert (HXd : x \notin dom E') by (exact (notin_union_2 x L (dom E') Hx)).
    (* need WF E' V *)
    assert (HwfV : WF E' V).
    { (* from typing_wf_env of the premise at some fresh x *)
      destruct (atom_fresh (L \u dom E')) as [y Hy].
      assert (HyL : y \notin L) by (exact (notin_union_1 y L (dom E') Hy)).
      pose proof (typing_wf_env (H y HyL)) as Hwext.
      apply wf_env_typ_inv in Hwext. destruct Hwext as [_ [HwfEV _]].
      apply (WF_binds_irrel HwfEV E' (fun Z Vb Hb => ex_intro (fun U => binds Z (bind_sub U) E') Vb (Hinc Z (bind_sub Vb) Hb))). }
    assert (Hext : wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E')) by (apply wf_env_typ; assumption).
    apply (H0 x HXL (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E') Hext).
    apply binds_incl_cons_same. exact Hinc.
  - (* app *)
    apply typing_app with (T1 := T1); [apply IHtyping1; assumption | apply IHtyping2; assumption].
  - (* tabs *)
    apply typing_tabs with (L := L \u dom E').
    intros X HX.
    assert (HXL : X \notin L) by (exact (notin_union_1 X L (dom E') HX)).
    assert (HXd : X \notin dom E') by (exact (notin_union_2 X L (dom E') HX)).
    assert (HwfV : WF E' V).
    { destruct (atom_fresh (L \u dom E')) as [Y HY].
      assert (HYL : Y \notin L) by (exact (notin_union_1 Y L (dom E') HY)).
      pose proof (typing_wf_env (H Y HYL)) as Hwext.
      apply wf_env_sub_inv in Hwext. destruct Hwext as [_ [HwfEV _]].
      apply (WF_binds_irrel HwfEV E' (fun Z Vb Hb => ex_intro (fun U => binds Z (bind_sub U) E') Vb (Hinc Z (bind_sub Vb) Hb))). }
    assert (Hext : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E')) by (apply wf_env_sub; assumption).

  - (* tapp *)
    apply typing_tapp with (T1 := T1).
    + apply IHtyping; assumption.
    + eapply sub_weaken_binds; [exact H0 | exact Hwe | intros Z V Hb; apply Hinc; exact Hb].
  - (* fold *)
    apply typing_fold with (A := A).
    + eapply sub_weaken_binds; [exact H | exact Hwe | intros Z V Hb; apply Hinc; exact Hb].
    + apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - (* unfold *)
    apply typing_unfold with (T := T).
    + apply IHtyping; assumption.
    + eapply sub_weaken_binds; [exact H0 | exact Hwe | intros Z V Hb; apply Hinc; exact Hb].
  - (* sub *)
    apply typing_sub with (S := S).
    + apply IHtyping; assumption.
    + eapply sub_weaken_binds; [exact H0 | exact Hwe | intros Z V Hb; apply Hinc; exact Hb].
  - (* proj *)
    apply typing_proj with (T := T). apply IHtyping; assumption. assumption.
  - (* rcd_nil *) apply typing_rcd_nil; assumption.
  - (* rcd_cons *)
    apply typing_rcd_cons with (T1 := T1) (T2 := T2).
    + apply IHtyping1; assumption.
    + apply IHtyping2; assumption.
    + assumption. + assumption. + assumption.
Qed.

Require Import Rules.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import Dev.Prelude.

Fixpoint lc_tt (k : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat | typ_top | typ_fvar _ | typ_rcd_nil => True
  | typ_bvar i => i < k
  | typ_arrow A B => lc_tt k A /\ lc_tt k B
  | typ_all A B => lc_tt k A /\ lc_tt (S k) B
  | typ_mu A => lc_tt (S k) A
  | typ_label _ A => lc_tt k A
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => lc_tt k A /\ lc_tt k B
  end.

Lemma lc_tt_open_id : forall k j X T,
  lc_tt k T -> k <= j -> open_tt_rec j X T = T.
Proof.
  intros k j X T H. revert j. induction T; simpl; intros j Hle; try reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (j === n) as [E|E]; [exfalso; lia|reflexivity].
  - (* arrow *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite IHT1; [rewrite IHT2; reflexivity|assumption|assumption].
  - (* all *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite IHT1; [rewrite (IHT2 (S j)); reflexivity|assumption|lia].
  - (* mu *) rewrite (IHT (S j)); [reflexivity|assumption|lia].
  - (* label *) rewrite IHT; [reflexivity|assumption|assumption].
  - (* rcd_cons *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite IHT1; [rewrite IHT2; reflexivity|assumption|assumption].
Qed.

Lemma lc_tt_open_inv_same : forall k X T,
  lc_tt k (open_tt_rec k X T) -> lc_tt (S k) T.
Proof.
  intros k X T. revert k. induction T; simpl; intros k H; try tauto.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (k === n) as [E|E]; simpl in *; lia.
  - (* arrow *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [apply IHT1 with X|apply IHT2 with X]; assumption.
  - (* all *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply IHT1 with X; assumption.
    + apply (IHT2 (S k) X). exact H2.
  - (* mu *) apply (IHT (S k) X). exact H.
  - (* label *) apply IHT with X; assumption.
  - (* rcd_cons *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [apply IHT1 with X|apply IHT2 with X]; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_lc_tt : forall E T, WF E T -> lc_tt 0 T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H.
  - simpl; exact I.
  - simpl; exact I.
  - simpl; exact I.
  - simpl. split; assumption.
  - simpl. split.
    + assumption.
    + destruct (atom_fresh L) as [X HX]. apply lc_tt_open_inv_same with (X:=X). apply H1. exact HX.
  - simpl. destruct (atom_fresh L) as [X HX]. apply lc_tt_open_inv_same with (X:=X). apply H0. exact HX.
  - simpl. assumption.
  - simpl; exact I.
  - simpl. split; assumption.
Qed.
EOF

Fixpoint lc_exp (k : nat) (e : exp) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ | exp_fvar _ | exp_nat | exp_rcd_nil => True
  | exp_abs V e1 => lc_tt k V /\ lc_exp k e1
  | exp_app e1 e2 => lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_exp k e2

  | exp_fold V e1 => lc_tt k V /\ lc_exp k e1
  | exp_rcd_cons _ e1 e2 => lc_exp k e1 /\ lc_exp k e2

  - (* rcd_cons *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHe1 k H1 Hle), (IHe2 k H2 Hle). reflexivity.
  - (* rcd_proj *) rewrite (IHe k H Hle). reflexivity.

  lc_exp k (open_te_rec k X e) -> lc_exp (S k) e.

Fixpoint collectLabele (e: exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) => {{i}} \u collectLabele e2
  | _ => {}
  end.

Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_var: forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      WF E (typ_all T1 T2)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A)
| WF_label: forall E A X,
    WF E A ->
    WF E (typ_label X A)
| WF_rcd_nil : forall E,
      WF E typ_rcd_nil
| WF_rcd_cons : forall E i T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      WF E T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabel T2) ->
      WF E (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Fixpoint fl_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) `union` (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fl_tt T)
  | typ_label X T => {{ X }} `union` fl_tt T
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) \u (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => {{i}} \u fl_tt T1 \u fl_tt T2
  end.

Fixpoint fv_env (E:env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
  end.

Fixpoint fl_env (E:env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fl_tt y) \u (fl_env E')
  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fl_tt y) \u (fl_env E')
  end.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :

  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),

      WF E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WF E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

| sa_nat: forall E,

| sa_fvar: forall E X,

    WF E (typ_fvar X) ->
    sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)

      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E e1 e2 T2,

      typing E e2 T1 ->
      typing E (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->

      sub G (typ_mu A) T ->

      typing E e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E e T

      Tlookup i T = Some Ti ->
      typing G (exp_rcd_proj e i) Ti

      wf_env G ->
      typing G exp_rcd_nil typ_rcd_nil

      typing G e1 T1 ->
      typing G e2 T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->

  | expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Fixpoint tlookup (i':var) (Er:exp) : option exp :=
  match Er with
  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) =>
      if i == i' then Some e1 else tlookup i' e2
  | _ => None
  end.

Inductive typing : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_nat: forall G,
    wf_env G ->
    typing G (exp_nat) (typ_nat)
  | typing_var : forall E x T,
      wf_env E ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E e1 e2 T2,
      typing E e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E e2 T1 ->
      typing E (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E e1 T T2,
      typing E e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_fold : forall G A T e ,
      sub G (typ_mu A) T ->
      typing G e (open_tt A T)  ->
      typing G (exp_fold T e) T
  | typing_unfold : forall G A T e,
     typing G e A -> sub G A (typ_mu T) ->
     typing G (exp_unfold A e)  (open_tt T A)
  | typing_sub : forall S E e T,
      typing E e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E e T
  | typing_proj : forall G e T i Ti,
      typing G e T ->
      Tlookup i T = Some Ti ->
      typing G (exp_rcd_proj e i) Ti
  | typing_rcd_nil : forall G,
      wf_env G ->
      typing G exp_rcd_nil typ_rcd_nil
  | typing_rcd_cons: forall G e1 e2 T1 T2 i,
      typing G e1 T1 ->
      typing G e2 T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      rt_expr e2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabele e2) ->
      typing G (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

  | value_tabs : forall t1 T,

  | value_fold: forall T e,

  | value_rcd_nil:

Fixpoint fv_te (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_bvar i => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {}
  | exp_abs V e1  => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_fold V e => fv_tt V \u fv_te e
  | exp_unfold V e => fv_tt V \u fv_te e
  | exp_rcd_nil => {}
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => (fv_te e1)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_ee (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_bvar i => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {{ x }}
  | exp_abs V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_fold V e => fv_ee e
  | exp_unfold V e => fv_ee e
  | exp_rcd_nil => {}
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => (fv_ee e1)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_te (Z : atom) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (subst_tt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (subst_tt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_tt Z U V)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold (subst_tt Z U V) (subst_te Z U e)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold (subst_tt Z U V) (subst_te Z U e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (subst_te Z U e1) i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_ee (z : atom) (u : exp) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => if x == z then u else e
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_ee z u e1) V
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (subst_ee z u e)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (subst_ee z u e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (subst_ee z u e1) i
  end.

Inductive Mode := Pos | Neg.

Definition choose (m : Mode)  (C : typ) (D : typ) :=
  match m with
  | Pos => C
  | Neg => D
  end.

Definition flip (m : Mode) : Mode :=
  match m with
  | Pos => Neg
  | Neg => Pos
  end.

Definition equiv E A B := sub E A B /\ sub E B A.

    z \notin fv_ee e ->
    typing (D ++ E) e T.

    + exact (IHtyping1 D E z W Heq Hz).

  - (* tabs *) subst G.

    + exact H0.

    + exact H.
    + exact (IHtyping D E z W Heq Hz).
  - (* unfold *) eapply typing_unfold.

    + exact H0.
  - (* sub *) eapply typing_sub.

Lemma typing_abs_apply_gen : forall E e T, typing E e T ->
  E = nil -> forall V e1, e = exp_abs V e1 ->
  forall A1 A2, T = typ_arrow A1 A2 ->
  forall u, typing nil u A1 -> typing nil (open_ee e1 u) A2.

  intros E e T H. induction H; intros Enil Vx ex Ee A1 A2 ET u Hu.

    assert (Hxu : x \notin fv_ee u) by fsetdec.
    pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
    pose proof (typing_lc Hu) as HlcA.
    pose proof (typing_lc_exp Hu) as HlcE.
    assert (Hwen : wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ nil)) by (apply typing_wf_env in Hbody; exact Hbody).
    pose proof (typing_weaken_binds Hu (x ~ bind_typ V ++ nil) Hwen
                  (fun Z b Hb => @binds_cons_any binding Z x b (bind_typ V) nil Hb)) as Hu'.
    pose proof (typing_subst_ee_aux Hbody Hu' HlcA HlcE

    + exact Hres.

  - (* tabs *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* tapp *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* fold *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* unfold *) discriminate Ee.

Require Import Rules.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import Dev.Prelude.

Lemma typing_fold_step_gen : forall E e T, typing E e T ->
  E = nil -> forall F x0 y0, e = exp_fold F x0 ->
  (forall A, typing nil x0 A -> typing nil y0 A) ->
  typing nil (exp_fold F y0) T.
Proof.
  intros E e T H. induction H; intros Enil F x0 y0 Ee Hstep.
  - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee.
  - (* fold *) injection Ee as HT He. subst F. subst x0. subst E.
    simpl. eapply typing_fold.
    + exact H.
    + apply Hstep. exact H0.
  - discriminate Ee.
  - (* sub *) subst E. eapply typing_sub.
    + apply (IHtyping eq_refl F x0 y0 Ee Hstep).
    + exact H0.
  - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee.
Qed.

Lemma typing_fold_step : forall F x y T,
  typing nil (exp_fold F x) T ->
  (forall A, typing nil x A -> typing nil y A) ->
  typing nil (exp_fold F y) T.
Proof. intros. exact (@typing_fold_step_gen nil (exp_fold F x) T H eq_refl F x y eq_refl H0). Qed.

Lemma typing_unfold_step_gen : forall E e T, typing E e T ->
  E = nil -> forall S x0 y0, e = exp_unfold S x0 ->
  (forall A, typing nil x0 A -> typing nil y0 A) ->
  typing nil (exp_unfold S y0) T.
Proof.
  intros E e T H. induction H; intros Enil S x0 y0 Ee Hstep.
  - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee.
  - (* unfold *) injection Ee as HS He. subst S. subst x0. subst E.
    simpl. eapply typing_unfold.
    + apply Hstep. exact H.
    + exact H0.
  - (* sub *) subst E. eapply typing_sub.
    + apply (IHtyping eq_refl S x0 y0 Ee Hstep).
    + exact H0.
  - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee.
Qed.

Lemma typing_unfold_step : forall S x y T,
  typing nil (exp_unfold S x) T ->
  (forall A, typing nil x A -> typing nil y A) ->
  typing nil (exp_unfold S y) T.
Proof. intros. exact (@typing_unfold_step_gen nil (exp_unfold S x) T H eq_refl S x y eq_refl H0). Qed.

Lemma typing_proj_step_gen : forall E e T, typing E e T ->
  E = nil -> forall x0 i, e = exp_rcd_proj x0 i ->
  (forall A, typing nil x0 A -> typing nil x0 A) ->
  typing nil (exp_rcd_proj x0 i) T.
Proof.
  intros E e T H. induction H; intros Enil x0 i Ee Hstep.
  - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee.
  - (* sub *) subst E. eapply typing_sub.
    + apply (IHtyping eq_refl x0 i Ee Hstep).
    + exact H0.
  - (* proj *) injection Ee as Hx Hi. subst x0. subst i. subst E.
    simpl. eapply typing_proj.
    + apply Hstep. exact H.
    + exact H0.
  - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee.
Qed.
EOF

Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_var: forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      WF E (typ_all T1 T2)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A)
| WF_label: forall E A X,
    WF E A ->
    WF E (typ_label X A)
| WF_rcd_nil : forall E,
      WF E typ_rcd_nil
| WF_rcd_cons : forall E i T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      WF E T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabel T2) ->
      WF E (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Fixpoint fl_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) `union` (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fl_tt T)
  | typ_label X T => {{ X }} `union` fl_tt T
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) \u (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => {{i}} \u fl_tt T1 \u fl_tt T2
  end.

  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (subst_ee z u e1) i
  end.

Inductive Mode := Pos | Neg.

Definition choose (m : Mode)  (C : typ) (D : typ) :=
  match m with
  | Pos => C
  | Neg => D
  end.

Definition flip (m : Mode) : Mode :=
  match m with
  | Pos => Neg
  | Neg => Pos
  end.

Definition equiv E A B := sub E A B /\ sub E B A.

  (forall Z V, binds Z (bind_sub V) E -> exists V', binds Z (bind_sub V') E') ->
  forall Z V, binds Z (bind_sub V) (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E) ->
    exists V', binds Z (bind_sub V') (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E').
Proof.
  intros X T E E' Hinc Z V Hb.
  apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[Heq Hveq]|Hb].
  - subst. exists T. simpl. left. reflexivity.
  - destruct (Hinc Z V Hb) as [V' HV']. exists V'. simpl. right. exact HV'.
Qed.

Lemma WF_binds_irrel : forall E T, WF E T ->

Inductive typing : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_nat: forall G,
    wf_env G ->
    typing G (exp_nat) (typ_nat)
  | typing_var : forall E x T,
      wf_env E ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E e1 e2 T2,
      typing E e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E e2 T1 ->
      typing E (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E e1 T T2,
      typing E e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_fold : forall G A T e ,
      sub G (typ_mu A) T ->
      typing G e (open_tt A T)  ->
      typing G (exp_fold T e) T
  | typing_unfold : forall G A T e,

Lemma lookup_some_in_collect : forall T i Ti,
  Tlookup i T = Some Ti -> i \in collectLabel T.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T; intros i Ti H; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  destruct (a == i) as [E|E]; subst; simpl in *.
  - injection H as H. subst Ti. apply notin_union_3.
    - apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity.
    - apply notin_empty_1.
  - right. apply IHT2. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma collect_lookup_some : forall T i,
  i \in collectLabel T -> exists Ti, Tlookup i T = Some Ti.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T; intros i H; simpl in *.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H.
  - apply notin_empty_1 in H. contradiction.
  - destruct (a == i) as [E|E].
    + subst. exists T1. simpl. destruct (a == a); [reflexivity|contradiction].
    + destruct H as [H|H].
      * exfalso. apply E. destruct (atom_eq_dec a i); auto. apply notin_singleton_1 in H; auto.
      * apply IHT2 in H as [Ti Hi]. exists Ti. simpl. destruct (a == i) as [E'|E']; [contradiction|exact Hi].
Qed.

Lemma lookup_subset : forall S T i Ti,
  collectLabel T [<=] collectLabel S ->
  Tlookup i T = Some Ti ->
  exists Si, Tlookup i S = Some Si.
Proof.
  intros S T i Ti Hsub Hl.
  assert (Hin : i \in collectLabel T) by (apply lookup_some_in_collect; exact Hl).
  apply Hsub in Hin.
  apply collect_lookup_some. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma sub_rcd_inv_nil : forall S T i Ti,
  sub nil S T ->
  Tlookup i T = Some Ti ->
  exists Si, Tlookup i S = Some Si /\ sub nil Si Ti.
Proof.
  intros S T i Ti H. induction H; intros Hl; try (simpl in Hl; discriminate).
  - (* nat *) simpl in Hl. discriminate.
  - (* fvar *) simpl in Hl. discriminate.
  - (* top *) simpl in Hl. discriminate.
  - (* trans_tvar *) simpl in Hl. discriminate.
  - (* arrow *) simpl in Hl. discriminate.
  - (* all *) simpl in Hl. discriminate.
  - (* rec *) simpl in Hl. discriminate.
  - (* label *) simpl in Hl. discriminate.
  - (* rcd *) rename A2 into T0. rename H into Hwe. rename H0 into Hrt1. rename H1 into Hrt2.
    rename H2 into HsubL. rename H3 into Hwf1. rename H4 into Hwf2. rename H5 into Hfields.
    destruct (lookup_subset HsubL Hl) as [Si HSi].
    exists Si. split; [exact HSi|].
    exact (Hfields i Si Ti HSi Hl).
Qed.
