Lemma sub_trans : forall E A B C,
  wf_env E -> sub E A B -> sub E B C -> sub E A C.
Proof. Admitted.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 6: substitution lemma for subtyping                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma sub_subst_gen : forall X V,
  X \notin fv_tt V ->
  forall D, X \notin dom D ->
  wf_env (D ++ (X, bind_sub V) :: nil) ->
  forall A B, sub (D ++ (X, bind_sub V) :: nil) A B ->
  forall U, sub nil U V -> lc_tt 0 U ->
  sub (subst_env X U D) (subst_tt X U A) (subst_tt X U B).
Proof.
  intros X V HXV.
  assert (Hmain : forall E A B, sub E A B ->
    forall D, X \notin dom D -> wf_env E -> E = D ++ (X, bind_sub V) :: nil ->
      forall U, sub nil U V -> lc_tt 0 U ->
      sub (subst_env X U D) (subst_tt X U A) (subst_tt X U B)).
  { apply Rules.sub_ind.
    - (* nat *) intros E Hwe D Hdom Hwf Heq U Hsub Hlc. subst E. simpl.
      apply sa_nat. apply (wf_env_subst_env D X V Hdom Hwf U Hsub Hlc).
    - (* fvar *) intros E Z Hwe HWF D Hdom Hwf Heq U Hsub Hlc. subst E.
      destruct (Z == X) as [eZ|eZ].
      + rewrite subst_tt_fvar_eq. apply sub_refl.
        * apply (wf_env_subst_env D X V Hdom Hwf U Hsub Hlc).
        * apply wf_nil_any. apply (proj1 (sub_wf Hsub)).
      + rewrite (subst_tt_fvar_neq X U Z (fun H => eZ (eq_sym H))).
        apply sa_fvar.
        * apply (wf_env_subst_env D X V Hdom Hwf U Hsub Hlc).
        * inversion HWF; subst. apply WF_var.
          pose proof (binds_subst_env (X:=X) (U:=U) (E:=D ++ (X, bind_sub V) :: nil)
                        (Y:=Z) (T:=T) H eZ) as Hbs.
          rewrite subst_env_app, subst_env_dist, app_nil_r in Hbs. exact Hbs.
    - (* top *) intros E A Hwe HWF D Hdom Hwf Heq U Hsub Hlc. subst E. simpl.
      apply sa_top.
      + apply (wf_env_subst_env D X V Hdom Hwf U Hsub Hlc).
      + apply (WF_subst_gen D X V A HWF U (proj1 (sub_wf Hsub))).
    - (* trans_tvar *) intros U0 E T Z Hb Hpre IHpre D Hdom Hwf Heq U Hsub Hlc. subst E.
      destruct (Z == X) as [eZ|eZ].
      + (* Z = X *) subst Z.
        pose proof (binds_distinguished_sub Hdom Hb) as Hbnd.
        injection Hbnd as HU0V. subst U0.
        pose proof (IHpre D Hdom Hwf eq_refl U Hsub Hlc) as HIH.
        rewrite subst_tt_id in HIH by exact HXV.
        rewrite subst_tt_fvar_eq.
        eapply sub_trans.
        * apply (wf_env_subst_env D X V Hdom Hwf U Hsub Hlc).
        * eapply sub_weaken_binds.
          -- exact Hsub.
          -- apply (wf_env_subst_env D X V Hdom Hwf U Hsub Hlc).
          -- intros Z' V' Hb'; inversion Hb'.
        * exact HIH.
      + (* Z <> X *)
        rewrite (subst_tt_fvar_neq X U Z (fun H => eZ (eq_sym H))).
        apply (sa_trans_tvar (U := subst_tt X U U0)).
        * pose proof (binds_subst_env (X:=X) (U:=U) (E:=D ++ (X, bind_sub V) :: nil)
                      (Y:=Z) (T:=U0) Hb eZ) as Hbs.
          rewrite subst_env_app, subst_env_dist, app_nil_r in Hbs. exact Hbs.
        * apply (IHpre D Hdom Hwf eq_refl U Hsub Hlc).
    - (* arrow *) intros E A1 A2 B1 B2 h1 IH1 h2 IH2 D Hdom Hwf Heq U Hsub Hlc. subst E. simpl.
      apply sa_arrow.
      + apply (IH1 D Hdom Hwf eq_refl U Hsub Hlc).
      + apply (IH2 D Hdom Hwf eq_refl U Hsub Hlc).
    - (* all *) intros L E S1 S2 T1 T2 h12 IH12 h21 IH21 hbody IHbody
                 D Hdom Hwf Heq U Hsub Hlc. subst E. simpl.
      apply sa_all with (L := (L \u dom D) \u {{X}}).
      + apply (IH12 D Hdom Hwf eq_refl U Hsub Hlc).
      + apply (IH21 D Hdom Hwf eq_refl U Hsub Hlc).
      + intros Y HY.
        destruct (notin_union_both HY) as [HY1 HYXs].
        destruct (notin_union_both HY1) as [HYL HYdom].
        pose proof (neq_of_notin_singleton Y X HYXs) as HYX.
        assert (Hdom' : X \notin dom ((Y, bind_sub S2) :: D)).
        { apply notin_add_3; [exact HYX | exact Hdom]. }
        assert (Hwf' : wf_env ((Y, bind_sub S2) :: D ++ (X, bind_sub V) :: nil)).
        { simpl. apply wf_env_sub.
          - exact Hwf.
          - apply (proj2 (sub_wf h12)).
          - apply notin_dom_app_cons; [exact HYdom | exact HYX]. }
        pose proof (IHbody Y HYL ((Y, bind_sub S2) :: D) Hdom' Hwf' eq_refl U Hsub Hlc) as Hres.
        rewrite (subst_env_cons_neq X U Y _ D HYX) in Hres.
        rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen in Hres.
        rewrite (subst_tt_fvar_neq X U Y (fun H => HYX (eq_sym H))) in Hres.
        simpl in Hres.
        rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen in Hres.
        rewrite (subst_tt_fvar_neq X U Y (fun H => HYX (eq_sym H))) in Hres.
        simpl in Hres. exact Hres.
    - (* rec *) intros L A1 A2 E w1 w2 hbody IHbody D Hdom Hwf Heq U Hsub Hlc. subst E. simpl.
      apply sa_rec with (L := (L \u dom D) \u {{X}}).
      + intros Y HY.
        destruct (notin_union_both HY) as [HY1 HYXs].
        destruct (notin_union_both HY1) as [HYL HYdom].
        pose proof (neq_of_notin_singleton Y X HYXs) as HYX.
        pose proof (WF_subst_gen ((Y, bind_sub typ_top) :: D) X V (open_tt A1 Y)
                      (w1 Y HYL) U (proj1 (sub_wf Hsub))) as Hres.
        rewrite (subst_env_cons_neq X U Y _ D HYX) in Hres.
        rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen in Hres.
        rewrite (subst_tt_fvar_neq X U Y (fun H => HYX (eq_sym H))) in Hres.
        simpl in Hres. exact Hres.
      + intros Y HY.
        destruct (notin_union_both HY) as [HY1 HYXs].
        destruct (notin_union_both HY1) as [HYL HYdom].
        pose proof (neq_of_notin_singleton Y X HYXs) as HYX.
        pose proof (WF_subst_gen ((Y, bind_sub typ_top) :: D) X V (open_tt A2 Y)
                      (w2 Y HYL) U (proj1 (sub_wf Hsub))) as Hres.
        rewrite (subst_env_cons_neq X U Y _ D HYX) in Hres.
        rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen in Hres.
        rewrite (subst_tt_fvar_neq X U Y (fun H => HYX (eq_sym H))) in Hres.
        simpl in Hres. exact Hres.
      + intros Y HY.
        destruct (notin_union_both HY) as [HY1 HYXs].
        destruct (notin_union_both HY1) as [HYL HYdom].
        pose proof (neq_of_notin_singleton Y X HYXs) as HYX.
        assert (Hdom' : X \notin dom ((Y, bind_sub typ_top) :: D)).
        { apply notin_add_3; [exact HYX | exact Hdom]. }
        assert (Hwf' : wf_env ((Y, bind_sub typ_top) :: D ++ (X, bind_sub V) :: nil)).
        { simpl. apply wf_env_sub.
          - exact Hwf.
          - apply WF_top.
          - apply notin_dom_app_cons; [exact HYdom | exact HYX]. }
        pose proof (IHbody Y HYL ((Y, bind_sub typ_top) :: D) Hdom' Hwf' eq_refl U Hsub Hlc) as Hres.
        rewrite (subst_env_cons_neq X U Y _ D HYX) in Hres.
        rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen in Hres.
        simpl in Hres.
        rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen in Hres.
        rewrite (subst_tt_fvar_neq X U Y (fun H => HYX (eq_sym H))) in Hres.
        simpl in Hres. exact Hres.
    - (* label *) intros E Z A B h IH D Hdom Hwf Heq U Hsub Hlc. subst E. simpl.
      apply sa_label. apply (IH D Hdom Hwf eq_refl U Hsub Hlc).
    - (* rcd *) intros A1 A2 E Hwe Hrt1 Hrt2 HsubL HWF1 HWF2 hpt IHpt
                 D Hdom Hwf Heq U Hsub Hlc. subst E. simpl.
      apply sa_rcd with (A1 := subst_tt X U A1) (A2 := subst_tt X U A2).
      + apply (wf_env_subst_env D X V Hdom Hwf U Hsub Hlc).
      + apply rt_type_subst_tt. exact Hrt1.
      + apply rt_type_subst_tt. exact Hrt2.
      + rewrite collectLabel_subst_tt, collectLabel_subst_tt. exact HsubL.
      + apply (WF_subst_gen D X V A1 HWF1 U (proj1 (sub_wf Hsub))).
      + apply (WF_subst_gen D X V A2 HWF2 U (proj1 (sub_wf Hsub))).
      + intros i t1 t2 Hl1 Hl2.
        rewrite Tlookup_subst_tt in Hl1.
        rewrite Tlookup_subst_tt in Hl2.
        apply option_map_Some_inv in Hl1. destruct Hl1 as [u1 [Hu1 Ht1]].
        apply option_map_Some_inv in Hl2. destruct Hl2 as [u2 [Hu2 Ht2]].
        subst t1. subst t2.
        apply (IHpt i u1 u2 Hu1 Hu2 D Hdom Hwf eq_refl U Hsub Hlc).
  }
  intros D Hdom Hwf A B Hsub U Hsub2 Hlc.
  exact (Hmain (D ++ (X, bind_sub V) :: nil) A B Hsub D Hdom Hwf eq_refl U Hsub2 Hlc).
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 7: substitution lemma for typing                         *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma typing_subst_te_gen : forall X V,
  X \notin fv_tt V ->
  forall U, sub nil U V -> lc_tt 0 U ->
  forall D e T,
  X \notin dom D ->
  wf_env (D ++ (X, bind_sub V) :: nil) ->
  typing (D ++ (X, bind_sub V) :: nil) e T ->
  typing (subst_env X U D) (subst_te X U e) (subst_tt X U T).
Proof.
  intros X V HXV U Hsub Hlc.
  assert (Hmain : forall E e T, typing E e T ->
    forall D, X \notin dom D -> wf_env E -> E = D ++ (X, bind_sub V) :: nil ->
      typing (subst_env X U D) (subst_te X U e) (subst_tt X U T)).
  { apply Rules.typing_ind.
    - (* nat *) intros G Hwe D Hdom Hwf Heq. subst G. simpl.
      apply typing_nat. apply (wf_env_subst_env D X V Hdom Hwf U Hsub Hlc).
    - (* var *) intros E x T Hwe Hb D Hdom Hwf Heq. subst E.
      assert (HxX : x <> X).
      { apply (binds_typ_neq_distinguished D X V x T Hdom Hb). }
      apply typing_var with (T := subst_tt X U T).
      + apply (wf_env_subst_env D X V Hdom Hwf U Hsub Hlc).
      + pose proof (binds_typ_subst_env (X:=X) (U:=U) (E:=D ++ (X, bind_sub V) :: nil)
                      (Y:=x) (T:=T) Hb HxX) as Hbs.
        rewrite subst_env_app, subst_env_dist, app_nil_r in Hbs. exact Hbs.
    - (* abs *) intros L E V0 e1 T1 hpre IHpre D Hdom Hwf Heq. subst E. simpl.
      apply typing_abs with (L := L \u {{X}}).
      intros x Hx.
      destruct (notin_union_both Hx) as [HxL HxXs].
      pose proof (neq_of_notin_singleton x X HxXs) as HxX.
      pose proof (typing_wf_env (hpre x HxL)) as Hwext.
      assert (Hdom' : X \notin dom ((x, bind_typ V0) :: D)).
      { apply notin_add_3; [exact HxX | exact Hdom]. }
      pose proof (IHpre x HxL ((x, bind_typ V0) :: D) Hdom' Hwext eq_refl) as Hres.
      rewrite (subst_env_cons_neq X U x (bind_typ V0) D HxX) in Hres.
      rewrite subst_te_open_ee_rec_gen in Hres. simpl in Hres.
      exact Hres.
    - (* app *) intros T1 E e1 e2 T2 h1 IH1 h2 IH2 D Hdom Hwf Heq. subst E. simpl.
      apply typing_app with (T1 := subst_tt X U T1).
      + apply (IH1 D Hdom Hwf eq_refl).
      + apply (IH2 D Hdom Hwf eq_refl).
    - (* tabs *) intros L E V0 e1 T1 hpre IHpre D Hdom Hwf Heq. subst E. simpl.
      apply typing_tabs with (L := L \u {{X}}).
      intros Y HY.
      destruct (notin_union_both HY) as [HYL HYXs].
      pose proof (neq_of_notin_singleton Y X HYXs) as HYX.
      pose proof (typing_wf_env (hpre Y HYL)) as Hwext.
      assert (Hdom' : X \notin dom ((Y, bind_sub V0) :: D)).
      { apply notin_add_3; [exact HYX | exact Hdom]. }
      pose proof (IHpre Y HYL ((Y, bind_sub V0) :: D) Hdom' Hwext eq_refl) as Hres.
      rewrite (subst_env_cons_neq X U Y (bind_sub V0) D HYX) in Hres.
      rewrite subst_te_open_te_rec_gen in Hres.
      rewrite (subst_tt_fvar_neq X U Y (fun H => HYX (eq_sym H))) in Hres.
      simpl in Hres.
      rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen in Hres.
      rewrite (subst_tt_fvar_neq X U Y (fun H => HYX (eq_sym H))) in Hres.
      simpl in Hres. exact Hres.
    - (* tapp *) intros T1 E e1 T T2 hpre IHpre hsub D Hdom Hwf Heq. subst E. simpl.
      rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen.
      pose proof (IHpre D Hdom Hwf eq_refl) as Hres. simpl in Hres.
      pose proof (sub_subst_gen X V HXV D Hdom Hwf T T1 hsub U Hsub Hlc) as Hs.
      apply typing_tapp with (T1 := subst_tt X U T1) (T2 := subst_tt X U T2)
                             (T := subst_tt X U T).
      + exact Hres.
      + exact Hs.
    - (* fold *) intros G A T e hsub hpre IHpre D Hdom Hwf Heq. subst G. simpl.
      rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen.
      pose proof (IHpre D Hdom Hwf eq_refl) as Hres.
      rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen in Hres.
      pose proof (sub_subst_gen X V HXV D Hdom Hwf (typ_mu A) T hsub U Hsub Hlc) as Hs.
      simpl in Hs.
      apply typing_fold with (A := subst_tt X U A) (T := subst_tt X U T).
      + exact Hs.
      + exact Hres.
    - (* unfold *) intros G A T e hpre IHpre hsub D Hdom Hwf Heq. subst G. simpl.
      rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen.
      pose proof (IHpre D Hdom Hwf eq_refl) as Hres.
      pose proof (sub_subst_gen X V HXV D Hdom Hwf A (typ_mu T) hsub U Hsub Hlc) as Hs.
      simpl in Hs.
      apply typing_unfold with (A := subst_tt X U A) (T := subst_tt X U T).
      + exact Hres.
      + exact Hs.
    - (* sub *) intros S E e T hpre IHpre hsub D Hdom Hwf Heq. subst E. simpl.
      pose proof (IHpre D Hdom Hwf eq_refl) as Hres.
      pose proof (sub_subst_gen X V HXV D Hdom Hwf S T hsub U Hsub Hlc) as Hs.
      apply typing_sub with (S := subst_tt X U S).
      + exact Hres.
      + exact Hs.
    - (* proj *) intros G e T i Ti hpre IHpre hlookup D Hdom Hwf Heq. subst G. simpl.
      pose proof (IHpre D Hdom Hwf eq_refl) as Hres.
      apply typing_proj with (T := subst_tt X U T) (i := i).
      + exact Hres.
      + rewrite Tlookup_subst_tt, hlookup. simpl. reflexivity.
    - (* rcd_nil *) intros G Hwe D Hdom Hwf Heq. subst G. simpl.
      apply typing_rcd_nil. apply (wf_env_subst_env D X V Hdom Hwf U Hsub Hlc).
    - (* rcd_cons *) intros G e1 e2 T1 T2 i h1 IH1 h2 IH2 hrt hrtx hn
                        D Hdom Hwf Heq. subst G. simpl.
      apply typing_rcd_cons with (T1 := subst_tt X U T1) (T2 := subst_tt X U T2).
      + apply (IH1 D Hdom Hwf eq_refl).
      + apply (IH2 D Hdom Hwf eq_refl).
      + apply rt_type_subst_tt. exact hrt.
      + apply rt_expr_subst_te. exact hrtx.
      + rewrite collectLabele_subst_te. exact hn.
  }
  intros D Hdom Hwf e T Hty.
  exact (Hmain (D ++ (X, bind_sub V) :: nil) e T Hty D Hdom Hwf eq_refl).
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 8: extraction of the tabs body from any typing derivation *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma typing_tabs_extract : forall E T1 e1 T,
  typing E (exp_tabs T1 e1) T ->
  exists L B,
    (forall X, X \notin L -> typing (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_te e1 X) (open_tt B X)) /\
    (T = typ_all T1 B \/ sub E (typ_all T1 B) T).
Proof.
  intros E T1 e1 T Hty.
  assert (Hmain : forall E0 e T0, typing E0 e T0 ->
    forall (T1 : typ) (e1 : exp) (T : typ),
      e = exp_tabs T1 e1 -> T0 = T ->
      exists L B,
        (forall X, X \notin L -> typing (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E0) (open_te e1 X) (open_tt B X)) /\
        (T = typ_all T1 B \/ sub E0 (typ_all T1 B) T)).
  { apply Rules.typing_ind.
    - (* nat *) intros G Hwe T1 e1 T He HT. discriminate He.
    - (* var *) intros E0 x T0 Hwe Hb T1 e1 T He HT. discriminate He.
    - (* abs *) intros L E0 V0 e1 T1 hpre IHpre T1' e1' T He HT. discriminate He.
    - (* app *) intros T1 E0 e1 e2 T2 h1 IH1 h2 IH2 T1' e1' T He HT. discriminate He.
    - (* tabs *) intros L E0 V0 e1 T1 hpre IHpre T1' e1' T He HT.
      injection He as HV Hee.
      exists L, T1. split.
      + intros X HX. subst V0. subst e1. exact (hpre X HX).
      + left. subst V0. symmetry. exact HT.
    - (* tapp *) intros T1 E0 e1 T T2 hpre IHpre hsub T1' e1' T0 He HT. discriminate He.
    - (* fold *) intros G A T e hsub hpre IHpre T1' e1' T0 He HT. discriminate He.
    - (* unfold *) intros G A T e hpre IHpre hsub T1' e1' T0 He HT. discriminate He.
    - (* sub *) intros S E0 e T0 hpre IHpre hsub T1 e1 T He HT.
      destruct (IHpre T1 e1 S He eq_refl) as (L & B & Hbody & [HeqS | HsubS]).
      + exists L, B. split; [exact Hbody|]. right.
        rewrite <- HeqS. exact hsub.
      + exists L, B. split; [exact Hbody|]. right.
        eapply sub_trans.
        * apply typing_wf_env in hpre. exact hpre.
        * exact HsubS.
        * exact hsub.
    - (* proj *) intros G e T i Ti hpre IHpre hlookup T1' e1' T0 He HT. discriminate He.
    - (* rcd_nil *) intros G Hwe T1 e1 T He HT. discriminate He.
    - (* rcd_cons *) intros G e1 e2 T1 T2 i h1 IH1 h2 IH2 hrt hrtx hn
                         T1' e1' T He HT. discriminate He.
  }
  exact (Hmain E (exp_tabs T1 e1) T Hty T1 e1 T eq_refl eq_refl).
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 9: the target lemma for typing_tabs                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma tabs_body_subst : forall T1 e1 A1 A2,
  typing nil (exp_tabs T1 e1) (typ_all A1 A2) ->
  forall T2, sub nil T2 A1 ->
  typing nil (open_te e1 T2) (open_tt A2 T2).
Proof.
  intros T1 e1 A1 A2 Hty T2 Hsub2.
  destruct (typing_tabs_extract Hty) as (L & B & Hbody & [Heq | Hsuball]).
  - (* exact shape *)
    injection Heq as HA1 HA2. subst A1. subst A2.
    assert (HWFV : WF nil T1) by (apply (proj2 (sub_wf Hsub2))).
    assert (HWFU : WF nil T2) by (apply (proj1 (sub_wf Hsub2))).
    assert (HlcU : lc_tt 0 T2) by (apply wf_lc_tt; exact HWFU).
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_te e1 \u fv_tt B \u fv_tt T1)) as [X HX].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX) as [HX1 HXT1].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX1) as [HX2 HXB].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX2) as [HX3 HXe].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX3) as [HXL _].
    assert (Hdomnil : X \notin dom (@nil (atom * binding))).
    { simpl. apply notin_empty_1. }
    assert (Hwe : wf_env (nil ++ (X, bind_sub T1) :: nil)).
    { simpl. apply wf_env_sub; [apply wf_env_empty | exact HWFV | exact Hdomnil]. }
    pose proof (typing_subst_te_gen X T1 HXT1 T2 Hsub2 HlcU nil
                  (open_te e1 X) (open_tt B X) Hdomnil Hwe (Hbody X HXL)) as Hres.
    rewrite subst_te_open_te_rec_gen in Hres.
    rewrite subst_tt_fvar_eq in Hres.
    rewrite subst_te_id in Hres by exact HXe.
    rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen in Hres.
    rewrite subst_tt_fvar_eq in Hres.
    rewrite subst_tt_id in Hres by exact HXB.
    exact Hres.
  - (* subtyping to the all-type *)
    apply sub_all_inv in Hsuball.
    destruct Hsuball as (L' & HsubT1 & HsubA1 & HbodySub).
    assert (HWFV : WF nil T1) by (apply (proj2 (sub_wf HsubT1))).
    assert (HWFV' : WF nil A1) by (apply (proj1 (sub_wf HsubT1))).
    assert (HWFU : WF nil T2) by (apply (proj1 (sub_wf Hsub2))).
    assert (HlcU : lc_tt 0 T2) by (apply wf_lc_tt; exact HWFU).
    assert (HsubT2T1 : sub nil T2 T1).
    { eapply sub_trans; [apply wf_env_empty | exact Hsub2 | exact HsubT1]. }
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u L' \u fv_te e1 \u fv_tt B \u fv_tt A2 \u fv_tt T1 \u fv_tt A1))
      as [X HX].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX) as [HX1 HXA1].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX1) as [HX2 HXT1].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX2) as [HX3 HXA2].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX3) as [HX4 HXB].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX4) as [HX5 HXe].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX5) as [HXL HXL'].
    assert (Hdomnil : X \notin dom (@nil (atom * binding))).
    { simpl. apply notin_empty_1. }
    (* first: substitute in the body typing, changing T1 to T2 *)
    assert (Hwe1 : wf_env (nil ++ (X, bind_sub T1) :: nil)).
    { simpl. apply wf_env_sub; [apply wf_env_empty | exact HWFV | exact Hdomnil]. }
    pose proof (typing_subst_te_gen X T1 HXT1 T2 HsubT2T1 HlcU nil
                  (open_te e1 X) (open_tt B X) Hdomnil Hwe1 (Hbody X HXL)) as HresTy.

1499	Lemma erase_id : forall X W T,
1500	  X \notin fv_tt T -> X \notin fl_tt T -> erase X W T = T.
1501	Proof.
1502	  intros X W T. induction T; simpl; intros Hfv Hfl; try reflexivity.
1503	  - (* fvar *) destruct (a == X) as [E|E].
1504	    + exfalso. apply Hfv. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. exact E.
1505	    + simpl. reflexivity.
1506	  - (* arrow *) apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as Hf1; apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as Hf2.
1507	    apply notin_union_1 in Hfl as Hg1; apply notin_union_2 in Hfl as Hg2.
1508	    rewrite (IHT1 Hf1 Hg1), (IHT2 Hf2 Hg2). reflexivity.
1509	  - (* all *) apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as Hf1; apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as Hf2.
1510	    apply notin_union_1 in Hfl as Hg1; apply notin_union_2 in Hfl as Hg2.
1511	    rewrite (IHT1 Hf1 Hg1), (IHT2 Hf2 Hg2). reflexivity.
1512	  - (* mu *) rewrite (IHT Hfv Hfl). reflexivity.
1513	  - (* label *) destruct (a == X) as [E|E].
1514	    + exfalso. apply notin_union_1 in Hfl as Hg1. exact (notin_singleton_1 a X Hg1 E).
1515	    + apply notin_union_2 in Hfl as Hg2. simpl. rewrite (IHT Hfv Hg2). reflexivity.
1516	  - (* rcd_cons *) apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as Hf1; apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as Hf2.
1517	    apply notin_union_2 in Hfl as Hgtail.
1518	    apply notin_union_1 in Hgtail as Hg1; apply notin_union_2 in Hgtail as Hg2.
1519	    rewrite (IHT1 Hf1 Hg1), (IHT2 Hf2 Hg2). reflexivity.

Require Import A1.Prelude.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import Coq.Arith.Wf_nat.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* A size measure on types that ignores the payload of labels.   *)
(* Its crucial property: opening at a variable or at a label     *)
(* (both have size 1) does not change the size.                  *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint sz (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 1
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bvar _ => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_arrow A B => 1 + sz A + sz B
  | typ_all A B => 1 + sz A + sz B
  | typ_mu A => 1 + sz A
  | typ_label _ _ => 1
  | typ_rcd_nil => 1
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => 1 + sz A + sz B
  end.

Lemma sz_pos : forall T, 0 < sz T.
Proof. intros T; destruct T; simpl; lia. Qed.

Lemma sz_bvar : forall i, sz (typ_bvar i) = 1.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sz_fvar : forall X, sz (typ_fvar X) = 1.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sz_label : forall X T, sz (typ_label X T) = 1.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sz_lt_arrow_l : forall A B, sz A < sz (typ_arrow A B).
Proof. intros; simpl; lia. Qed.

Lemma sz_lt_arrow_r : forall A B, sz B < sz (typ_arrow A B).
Proof. intros; simpl; lia. Qed.

Lemma sz_lt_all_l : forall A B, sz A < sz (typ_all A B).
Proof. intros; simpl; lia. Qed.

Lemma sz_lt_all_r : forall A B, sz B < sz (typ_all A B).
Proof. intros; simpl; lia. Qed.

Lemma sz_lt_mu : forall A, sz A < sz (typ_mu A).
Proof. intros; simpl; lia. Qed.

Lemma sz_lt_label : forall X A, sz A < sz (typ_label X A).
Proof. intros; simpl; lia. Qed.

Lemma sz_lt_rcd_l : forall i A B, sz A < sz (typ_rcd_cons i A B).
Proof. intros; simpl; lia. Qed.

Lemma sz_lt_rcd_r : forall i A B, sz B < sz (typ_rcd_cons i A B).
Proof. intros; simpl; lia. Qed.

(* Opening at a type of size 1 preserves sz. *)

Lemma sz_open_tt_rec_unit : forall T,
  forall W, sz W = 1 -> forall K, sz (open_tt_rec K W T) = sz T.
Proof.
  induction T; intros W HW K; simpl; auto.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (K === n); simpl; auto.
  - (* arrow *) rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
  - (* all *) rewrite IHT1, (IHT2 W HW (S K)); auto.
  - (* mu *) rewrite (IHT W HW (S K)); auto.
  - (* label *) reflexivity.
  - (* rcd_cons *) rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sz_open_tt_unit : forall T W,
  sz W = 1 -> sz (open_tt T W) = sz T.
Proof. intros; apply sz_open_tt_rec_unit; auto. Qed.

Lemma sz_open_tt_fvar : forall T X, sz (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = sz T.
Proof. intros; apply sz_open_tt_unit; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sz_open_tt_label : forall T X U,
  sz (open_tt T (typ_label X U)) = sz T.
Proof. intros; apply sz_open_tt_unit; reflexivity. Qed.

(* A lookup in a record yields a strictly smaller type. *)

Lemma sz_Tlookup_lt : forall T i Ti,
  Tlookup i T = Some Ti -> sz Ti < sz T.
Proof.
  induction T; intros i Ti H; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  - (* rcd_cons *)
    destruct (a == i) as [E|E].
    + injection H as H; subst Ti. simpl; lia.
    + simpl. pose proof (IHT2 i Ti H). lia.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Every subtyping derivation lives in a well-formed env.        *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma sub_wf_env : forall E A B, sub E A B -> wf_env E.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction H.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
  - apply IHsub.
  - apply IHsub1.
  - apply IHsub.
  - (* sa_rec: body premise is in X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E *)
    assert (Hw : wf_env (X0 ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)).
    { apply IHsub. }
    destruct (wf_env_sub_inv E X0 typ_top Hw) as [HwE _]. exact HwE.
  - apply IHsub.
  - assumption.
Qed.

Definition subst_binding (X : atom) (U : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with

===
    assert (HWFU : WF nil T2) by (apply (proj1 (sub_wf Hsub2))).
    assert (HlcU : lc_tt 0 T2) by (apply wf_lc_tt; exact HWFU).
    assert (HsubT2T1 : sub nil T2 T1).
    { eapply sub_trans; [apply wf_env_empty | exact Hsub2 | exact HsubT1]. }
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u L' \u fv_te e1 \u fv_tt B \u fv_tt A2 \u fv_tt T1 \u fv_tt A1))
      as [X HX].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX) as [HX1 HXA1].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX1) as [HX2 HXT1].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX2) as [HX3 HXA2].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX3) as [HX4 HXB].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX4) as [HX5 HXe].
    destruct (notin_union_both HX5) as [HXL HXL'].
    assert (Hdomnil : X \notin dom (@nil (atom * binding))).
    { simpl. apply notin_empty_1. }
    (* first: substitute in the body typing, changing T1 to T2 *)
    assert (Hwe1 : wf_env (nil ++ (X, bind_sub T1) :: nil)).
    { simpl. apply wf_env_sub; [apply wf_env_empty | exact HWFV | exact Hdomnil]. }
    pose proof (typing_subst_te_gen X T1 HXT1 T2 HsubT2T1 HlcU nil
                  (open_te e1 X) (open_tt B X) Hdomnil Hwe1 (Hbody X HXL)) as HresTy.
    rewrite subst_te_open_te_rec_gen in HresTy.
    rewrite subst_tt_fvar_eq in HresTy.
    rewrite subst_te_id in HresTy by exact HXe.
    rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen in HresTy.
    rewrite subst_tt_fvar_eq in HresTy.
    rewrite subst_tt_id in HresTy by exact HXB.
    (* second: substitute in the subtyping premise, changing A1 to T2 *)
    assert (Hwe2 : wf_env (nil ++ (X, bind_sub A1) :: nil)).
    { simpl. apply wf_env_sub; [apply wf_env_empty | exact HWFV' | exact Hdomnil]. }
    pose proof (sub_subst_gen X A1 HXA1 nil Hdomnil Hwe2
                  (open_tt B X) (open_tt A2 X) (HbodySub X HXL') T2 Hsub2 HlcU) as HresSub.
    rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen in HresSub.
    rewrite subst_tt_fvar_eq in HresSub.
    rewrite subst_tt_id in HresSub by exact HXB.
    rewrite subst_tt_open_tt_rec_gen in HresSub.
    rewrite subst_tt_fvar_eq in HresSub.
    rewrite subst_tt_id in HresSub by exact HXA2.
    apply typing_sub with (S := open_tt B T2).
    + exact HresTy.
    + exact HresSub.
Qed.

Lemma sub_top_inv : forall E T, sub E typ_top T -> T = typ_top.
Proof.
  intros E T H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate; try reflexivity;
  try (exfalso; match goal with
       | Hr : rt_type typ_top |- _ => inversion Hr
       | Hb : binds _ (bind_sub _) _ |- _ => inversion Hb
       end).
Qed.

Lemma erase_fvar_eq : forall X W, erase X W (typ_fvar X) = W.
Proof. intros. simpl. destruct (X == X) as [E|E]; [reflexivity|contradiction]. Qed.

Lemma erase_label_eq : forall X W T, erase X W (typ_label X T) = W.
Proof. intros. simpl. destruct (X == X) as [E|E]; [reflexivity|contradiction]. Qed.

Lemma sub_erase : forall E, wf_env E -> forall Xs,
  binds Xs (bind_sub typ_top) E ->
  forall A B, sub E A B ->
  forall Wt, WF nil Wt ->
  sub (erase_env Xs Wt E) (erase Xs Wt A) (erase Xs Wt B).
Proof.
  intros E Hwe Xs Hb A B H. induction H; intros Wt Hwnil.
  - (* nat *) simpl. apply sa_nat. apply (@wf_env_erase E Hwe Xs Wt Hwnil).
  - (* fvar *) destruct (X == Xs) as [E1|E1].
    + subst X. rewrite erase_fvar_eq.
      apply sub_refl; [apply (@wf_env_erase E Hwe Xs Wt Hwnil)|apply wf_nil_any; exact Hwnil].
    + rewrite (@erase_fvar_neq Xs Wt X E1).
      apply sa_fvar.
      * apply (@wf_env_erase E Hwe Xs Wt Hwnil).
      * pose proof (@wf_erase E (typ_fvar X) H0 Xs Wt Hwnil) as HwfE.
        rewrite (@erase_fvar_neq Xs Wt X E1) in HwfE. exact HwfE.
  - (* top *) simpl. apply sa_top.
    + apply (@wf_env_erase E Hwe Xs Wt Hwnil).
    + apply (@wf_erase E A H0 Xs Wt Hwnil).
  - (* trans_tvar *) destruct (X == Xs) as [E1|E1].
    + subst X. assert (Heq : bind_sub U = bind_sub typ_top) by (eapply binds_unique; eauto using wf_env_uniq).
      injection Heq as HU. subst U. rewrite (sub_top_inv H0). rewrite erase_fvar_eq. simpl.
      apply sa_top.
      * apply (@wf_env_erase E Hwe Xs Wt Hwnil).
      * apply wf_nil_any. exact Hwnil.
    + rewrite (@erase_fvar_neq Xs Wt X E1).
      eapply sa_trans_tvar.
      * apply (@binds_erase E X (bind_sub U) H Xs Wt E1).
      * apply (IHsub Hwe Hb Wt Hwnil).
  - (* arrow *) simpl. apply sa_arrow; [apply (IHsub1 Hwe Hb Wt Hwnil)|apply (IHsub2 Hwe Hb Wt Hwnil)].
  - (* all *) simpl. apply sa_all with (L := L \u dom E \u {{Xs}}).
    + apply (IHsub1 Hwe Hb Wt Hwnil).
    + apply (IHsub2 Hwe Hb Wt Hwnil).
    + intros Y HY. assert (HYL : Y \notin L) by fsetdec.
      assert (HYd : Y \notin dom E) by fsetdec.
      assert (HYX : Y <> Xs) by fsetdec.
      assert (HwfS2 : WF E S2) by (apply (proj2 (sub_wf H))).
      assert (HweY : wf_env (Y ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E)) by (apply wf_env_sub; assumption).
      assert (HbY : binds Xs (bind_sub typ_top) (Y ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E)) by (apply binds_cons; exact Hb).
      pose proof (H2 Y HYL HweY HbY Wt Hwnil) as Hres.
      change (sub (erase_env Xs Wt ((Y, bind_sub S2) :: E))
                 (erase Xs Wt (open_tt T1 Y)) (erase Xs Wt (open_tt T2 Y))) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_env_cons_neq Xs Wt Y (bind_sub S2) E HYX) in Hres.
      unfold open_tt in Hres |- *.
      rewrite (@erase_open Xs Wt 0 (typ_fvar Y) T1 (wf_lc_tt Hwnil)) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_open Xs Wt 0 (typ_fvar Y) T2 (wf_lc_tt Hwnil)) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_fvar_neq Xs Wt Y HYX) in Hres.
      exact Hres.
  - (* rec *) simpl. apply sa_rec with (L := L \u dom E \u {{Xs}}).
    + intros Y HY. assert (HYL : Y \notin L) by fsetdec.
      assert (HYd : Y \notin dom E) by fsetdec.
      assert (HYX : Y <> Xs) by fsetdec.
      pose proof (@wf_erase (Y ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 Y) (H Y HYL) Xs Wt Hwnil) as Hres.
      change (WF (erase_env Xs Wt ((Y, bind_sub typ_top) :: E))
                (erase Xs Wt (open_tt A1 Y))) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_env_cons_neq Xs Wt Y (bind_sub typ_top) E HYX) in Hres.
      unfold open_tt in Hres |- *.
      rewrite (@erase_open Xs Wt 0 (typ_fvar Y) A1 (wf_lc_tt Hwnil)) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_fvar_neq Xs Wt Y HYX) in Hres.
      exact Hres.
    + intros Y HY. assert (HYL : Y \notin L) by fsetdec.
      assert (HYd : Y \notin dom E) by fsetdec.
      assert (HYX : Y <> Xs) by fsetdec.
      pose proof (@wf_erase (Y ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A2 Y) (H0 Y HYL) Xs Wt Hwnil) as Hres.
      change (WF (erase_env Xs Wt ((Y, bind_sub typ_top) :: E))
                (erase Xs Wt (open_tt A2 Y))) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_env_cons_neq Xs Wt Y (bind_sub typ_top) E HYX) in Hres.
      unfold open_tt in Hres |- *.
      rewrite (@erase_open Xs Wt 0 (typ_fvar Y) A2 (wf_lc_tt Hwnil)) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_fvar_neq Xs Wt Y HYX) in Hres.
      exact Hres.
    + intros Y HY. assert (HYL : Y \notin L) by fsetdec.
      assert (HYd : Y \notin dom E) by fsetdec.
      assert (HYX : Y <> Xs) by fsetdec.
      assert (HweY : wf_env (Y ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)) by (apply wf_env_sub; [exact Hwe|apply WF_top|exact HYd]).
      assert (HbY : binds Xs (bind_sub typ_top) (Y ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)) by (apply binds_cons; exact Hb).
      pose proof (H2 Y HYL HweY HbY Wt Hwnil) as Hres.
      change (sub (erase_env Xs Wt ((Y, bind_sub typ_top) :: E))
                 (erase Xs Wt (open_tt_rec 0 (typ_label Y (open_tt_rec 0 (typ_fvar Y) A1)) A1))
                 (erase Xs Wt (open_tt_rec 0 (typ_label Y (open_tt_rec 0 (typ_fvar Y) A2)) A2))) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_env_cons_neq Xs Wt Y (bind_sub typ_top) E HYX) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_open Xs Wt 0 (typ_label Y (open_tt_rec 0 (typ_fvar Y) A1)) A1 (wf_lc_tt Hwnil)) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_open Xs Wt 0 (typ_label Y (open_tt_rec 0 (typ_fvar Y) A2)) A2 (wf_lc_tt Hwnil)) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_label_neq Xs Wt Y (open_tt_rec 0 (typ_fvar Y) A1) HYX) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_label_neq Xs Wt Y (open_tt_rec 0 (typ_fvar Y) A2) HYX) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_open Xs Wt 0 (typ_fvar Y) A1 (wf_lc_tt Hwnil)) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_open Xs Wt 0 (typ_fvar Y) A2 (wf_lc_tt Hwnil)) in Hres.
      rewrite (@erase_fvar_neq Xs Wt Y HYX) in Hres.
      exact Hres.
  - (* label *) destruct (X == Xs) as [E1|E1].
    + subst X. rewrite erase_label_eq. rewrite erase_label_eq.
      apply sub_refl; [apply (@wf_env_erase E Hwe Xs Wt Hwnil)|apply wf_nil_any; exact Hwnil].
    + rewrite (@erase_label_neq Xs Wt X A E1).
      rewrite (@erase_label_neq Xs Wt X B E1).
      apply sa_label. apply (IHsub Hwe Hb Wt Hwnil).
  - (* rcd *) simpl. apply sa_rcd with (A1 := erase Xs Wt A1) (A2 := erase Xs Wt A2).
    + apply (@wf_env_erase E Hwe Xs Wt Hwnil).
    + apply rt_type_erase. exact H0.
    + apply rt_type_erase. exact H1.
    + rewrite (@collectLabel_erase_rt E A2 H4 H1 Xs Wt).
      rewrite (@collectLabel_erase_rt E A1 H3 H0 Xs Wt). exact H2.
    + apply (@wf_erase E A1 H3 Xs Wt Hwnil).
    + apply (@wf_erase E A2 H4 Xs Wt Hwnil).
    + intros i t1 t2 Hl1 Hl2.
      rewrite (@Tlookup_erase_rt_wf E A1 H3 H0 Xs Wt i) in Hl1.
      rewrite (@Tlookup_erase_rt_wf E A2 H4 H1 Xs Wt i) in Hl2.
      destruct (Tlookup i A1) as [u1|] eqn:Lu1; [|discriminate Hl1].
      destruct (Tlookup i A2) as [u2|] eqn:Lu2; [|discriminate Hl2].
      simpl in Hl1, Hl2. injection Hl1 as Ht1. injection Hl2 as Ht2. subst t1 t2.
      apply (H6 i u1 u2 Lu1 Lu2 Hwe Hb Wt Hwnil).
Qed.

Lemma rt_expr_step : forall e e', rt_expr e -> step e e' -> rt_expr e'.
Proof.
  intros e e' Hrt Hstep. inversion Hrt; subst.
  - inversion Hstep.
  - inversion Hstep; subst; apply rt_expr_rcd_cons.

Inductive sub_chain : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sc_refl : forall E T, sub_chain E T T
  | sc_step : forall E S T U, sub E S T -> sub_chain E T U -> sub_chain E S U.

Lemma sub_chain_from_top : forall E U, sub_chain E typ_top U -> U = typ_top.
Proof.
  intros E U H. remember typ_top as S eqn:HS. revert HS.
  induction H; intros HS.
  - reflexivity.
  - subst S.
    assert (HT : T = typ_top) by (eapply sub_top_inv; eassumption).
    subst T. apply IHsub_chain. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sub_record_labels : forall E S T,
  rt_type S -> sub E S T -> rt_type T ->
  collectLabel T [<=] collectLabel S.
Proof.
  intros E S T HrtS Hsub HrtT.
  inversion Hsub; subst.
  - inversion HrtS.
  - inversion HrtS.
  - inversion HrtT.
  - inversion HrtS.
  - inversion HrtS.
  - inversion HrtS.
  - inversion HrtS.
  - inversion HrtS.
  - assumption.

Lemma sub_record_rt : forall E S T,
  rt_type S -> sub E S T -> rt_type T \/ T = typ_top.
Proof.
  intros E S T HrtS Hsub.
  inversion Hsub; subst.
  - inversion HrtS.
  - inversion HrtS.
  - right. reflexivity.
  - inversion HrtS.
  - inversion HrtS.
  - inversion HrtS.
  - inversion HrtS.
  - inversion HrtS.
  - left. eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_chain_rt_labels : forall E S T,
  rt_type S -> sub_chain E S T -> rt_type T ->
  collectLabel T [<=] collectLabel S.

  intros E S T HrtS Hch. induction Hch; intros HrtT.

  - destruct (@sub_record_rt E S T HrtS H) as [HrtT0|Htop].

      pose proof (@sub_chain_from_top E U Hch) as Heq. subst U.

Require Export Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_nat : typ
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : var -> typ
  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_mu : typ -> typ
  | typ_label : var -> typ -> typ
  | typ_rcd_nil : typ
  | typ_rcd_cons : var -> typ -> typ -> typ
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_nat : exp
  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_nil : exp
  | exp_rcd_cons : var -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_proj : exp -> var -> exp
.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
  | typ_top         => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (open_tt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_label l T        => typ_label l (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Inductive rt_type : typ -> Prop :=
  | rt_type_rcd_nil :
      rt_type typ_rcd_nil
  | rt_type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      rt_type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_nat :
      type typ_nat
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_mu : forall L T,
      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_mu T)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_label: forall l A,
      type A ->
      type (typ_label l A)
  | type_rcd_nil :
      type typ_rcd_nil
  | type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2).

Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_label l T => typ_label l (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_label l T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => fv_tt T1 \u fv_tt T2
  end.

Inductive binding : Set :=
| bind_sub : typ -> binding
| bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Fixpoint Tlookup (i':var) (Tr:typ) : option typ :=
  match Tr with
  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) =>
      if i == i' then Some T1 else Tlookup i' T2
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint collectLabel (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) => {{i}} \u collectLabel T2
  | _ => {}
  end.

Fixpoint collectLabele (e: exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) => {{i}} \u collectLabele e2
  | _ => {}
  end.

Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_var: forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      WF E (typ_all T1 T2)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A)
| WF_label: forall E A X,
    WF E A ->
    WF E (typ_label X A)
| WF_rcd_nil : forall E,
      WF E typ_rcd_nil
| WF_rcd_cons : forall E i T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      WF E T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabel T2) ->
      WF E (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Fixpoint fl_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) `union` (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fl_tt T)
  | typ_label X T => {{ X }} `union` fl_tt T
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) \u (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => {{i}} \u fl_tt T1 \u fl_tt T2
  end.

Fixpoint fv_env (E:env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Scratch file for the recursive-subtyping self-unrolling task  *)
(* Work area /tmp/a3.  Requires the compiled snapshot Prelude.v. *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Require Import A3.Prelude.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SCRATCH-ONLY PLACEHOLDER, explicitly permitted by the task:  *)
(* general transitivity of subtyping is admitted here and ONLY  *)
(* here.  The target lemma below is NOT proved using Admitted.   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Lemma sub_trans : forall E A B C,
  sub E A B -> sub E B C -> sub E A C.
Proof. Admitted.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 1.  Erasing an absent atom from an environment.          *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma erase_env_id : forall E (X : atom) (W : typ),
  X \notin dom E ->
  X \notin fv_env E ->
  X \notin fl_env E ->
  erase_env X W E = E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [Y b] E IH]; intros X W Hd Hfv Hfl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct b as [T|T]; simpl in Hd, Hfv, Hfl.
    + (* bind_sub *)
      apply notin_add_1 in Hd as Hne.
      apply notin_add_2 in Hd as Hd'.
      apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as HfvT.
      apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as HfvE.
      apply notin_union_1 in Hfl as HflT.
      apply notin_union_2 in Hfl as HflE.
      destruct (Y == X) as [Heq|Hneq].
      * exfalso. apply Hne. symmetry. exact Heq.
      * simpl. rewrite (erase_id X W T HfvT HflT).
        rewrite (IH X W Hd' HfvE HflE). reflexivity.
    + (* bind_typ *)
      apply notin_add_1 in Hd as Hne.
      apply notin_add_2 in Hd as Hd'.
      apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as HfvT.
      apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as HfvE.
      apply notin_union_1 in Hfl as HflT.
      apply notin_union_2 in Hfl as HflE.
      destruct (Y == X) as [Heq|Hneq].
      * exfalso. apply Hne. symmetry. exact Heq.
      * simpl. rewrite (erase_id X W T HfvT HflT).
        rewrite (IH X W Hd' HfvE HflE). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 2.  Kernel unrolling with a fresh knot variable X:       *)
(* erasing the knot by ANY closed W gives the same-argument      *)
(* unrolling of an arbitrary kernel derivation.                  *)
(* This is exactly the tool suggested by the coordinator's hint: *)
(* it applies to arrow/label subderivations too, not only to the *)
(* top-level kernel.                                             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma kernel_unroll : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (A B : typ),
  wf_env E ->
  X \notin dom E ->
  X \notin fv_env E ->
  X \notin fl_env E ->
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  X \notin fl_tt A ->
  X \notin fv_tt B ->
  X \notin fl_tt B ->
  sub (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)
      (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))
      (open_tt B (typ_label X (open_tt B X))) ->
  forall W, WF nil W -> sub E (open_tt A W) (open_tt B W).
Proof.
  intros E X A B Hwe HXd HXfvE HXflE HXfvA HXflA HXfvB HXflB HK W Hwnil.
  assert (HweX : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)).
  { apply wf_env_sub.
    - exact Hwe.
    - apply WF_top.
    - exact HXd. }
  assert (HbX : binds X (bind_sub typ_top) (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)).
  { simpl. left. reflexivity. }
  pose proof (@sub_erase (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) HweX X HbX
     (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))
     (open_tt B (typ_label X (open_tt B X))) HK W Hwnil) as Hres.
  assert (Heenv : erase_env X W (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) = E).
  { change (erase_env X W ((X, bind_sub typ_top) :: E) = E).
    rewrite erase_env_cons_eq with (Y := X) (b := bind_sub typ_top) (E := E)
      by reflexivity.
    apply erase_env_id; assumption. }
  rewrite Heenv in Hres.
  unfold open_tt in Hres.
  rewrite (@erase_open X W 0 (typ_label X (open_tt_rec 0 X A)) A
             (wf_lc_tt Hwnil)) in Hres.
  rewrite (@erase_open X W 0 (typ_label X (open_tt_rec 0 X B)) B
             (wf_lc_tt Hwnil)) in Hres.
  rewrite erase_label_eq in Hres.
  rewrite erase_label_eq in Hres.
  rewrite (@erase_id X W A HXfvA HXflA) in Hres.
  rewrite (@erase_id X W B HXfvB HXflB) in Hres.
  unfold open_tt in *. exact Hres.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 3.  Same-argument unrolling for an arbitrary env,        *)
(* directly from the hypothesis  sub E (mu A) (mu B).           *)
(* This generalises Task.v's sub_unroll_same and is the piece    *)
(* that discharges every component in which the recursive        *)
(* variable is absent / when a closed W can be used.             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma sub_unroll_same_E : forall (E : env) (A B : typ),
  wf_env E ->
  sub E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B) ->
  forall W, WF nil W -> sub E (open_tt A W) (open_tt B W).
Proof.
  intros E A B Hwe H W Hwnil.
  destruct (sub_mu_inv H) as [L [HwfA [HwfB HK]]].
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u dom E \u fv_env E \u fl_env E
                          \u fv_tt A \u fl_tt A \u fv_tt B \u fl_tt B))
    as [X HX].
  assert (HXL : X \notin L) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXd : X \notin dom E) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXfvE : X \notin fv_env E) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXflE : X \notin fl_env E) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXfvA : X \notin fv_tt A) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXflA : X \notin fl_tt A) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXfvB : X \notin fv_tt B) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXflB : X \notin fl_tt B) by fsetdec.
  eapply kernel_unroll; eauto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 4.  Fully proved partial cases of the target.            *)
(* ============================================================ *)

(* If one of the two bodies is closed (no occurrence of the      *)
(* recursive parameter), the target follows immediately from     *)
(* same-argument unrolling with the OTHER unfolding as W.        *)

Lemma sub_unroll_self_nil_lc0_left : forall (A B : typ),
  sub nil (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B) ->
  lc_tt 0 A ->
  sub nil (open_tt A (typ_mu A)) (open_tt B (typ_mu B)).
Proof.
  intros A B H Hlc.
  destruct (sub_wf H) as [_ HwfB].
  pose proof (@sub_unroll_same_E nil A B wf_env_empty H
                (typ_mu B) HwfB) as Hres.
  rewrite (@lc_tt_open_any A Hlc 0 (typ_mu B)) in Hres.
  rewrite (@lc_tt_open_any A Hlc 0 (typ_mu A)) in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.

Lemma sub_unroll_self_nil_lc0_right : forall (A B : typ),
  sub nil (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B) ->
  lc_tt 0 B ->
  sub nil (open_tt A (typ_mu A)) (open_tt B (typ_mu B)).
Proof.
  intros A B H Hlc.
  destruct (sub_wf H) as [HwfA _].
  pose proof (@sub_unroll_same_E nil A B wf_env_empty H
                (typ_mu A) HwfA) as Hres.
  rewrite (@lc_tt_open_any B Hlc 0 (typ_mu A)) in Hres.
  rewrite (@lc_tt_open_any B Hlc 0 (typ_mu B)) in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.

Lemma sub_unroll_self_nil_lc0 : forall (A B : typ),
  sub nil (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B) ->
  (lc_tt 0 A \/ lc_tt 0 B) ->
  sub nil (open_tt A (typ_mu A)) (open_tt B (typ_mu B)).
Proof.
  intros A B H [HA|HB].
  - eapply sub_unroll_self_nil_lc0_left; eauto.
  - eapply sub_unroll_self_nil_lc0_right; eauto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 5.  Exact decomposition of the remaining obligation.     *)
(*                                                               *)
(* Same-argument unrolling gives the two edges of the square     *)
(*                                                               *)
(*   A[muA] --(W := muA)--> B[muA]                               *)
(*     |                       |                                 *)
(*   A[muB] --(W := muB)--> B[muB]                               *)
(*                                                               *)
(* The target is the diagonal A[muA] -> B[muB].  It follows by   *)
(* the (admitted) transitivity as soon as EITHER vertical edge   *)
(* ("bridge") is available.  The two lemmas below are therefore  *)
(* fully proved reductions of the target to exactly one bridge.  *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma sub_unroll_self_nil_of_bridge_A : forall (A B : typ),
  sub nil (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B) ->
  sub nil (open_tt A (typ_mu A)) (open_tt A (typ_mu B)) ->
  sub nil (open_tt A (typ_mu A)) (open_tt B (typ_mu B)).
Proof.
  intros A B H Hbridge.
  destruct (sub_wf H) as [_ HwfB].
  eapply sub_trans.
  - exact Hbridge.
  - apply (@sub_unroll_same_E nil A B wf_env_empty H (typ_mu B) HwfB).
Qed.

Lemma sub_unroll_self_nil_of_bridge_B : forall (A B : typ),
  sub nil (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B) ->
  sub nil (open_tt B (typ_mu A)) (open_tt B (typ_mu B)) ->
  sub nil (open_tt A (typ_mu A)) (open_tt B (typ_mu B)).
Proof.
  intros A B H Hbridge.
  destruct (sub_wf H) as [HwfA _].
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply (@sub_unroll_same_E nil A B wf_env_empty H (typ_mu A) HwfA).
  - exact Hbridge.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 6.  Conditional full target under the missing bridge.    *)
(* (This is a proved implication; the bridge itself is the open  *)
(* obligation, discussed in the report.)                         *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma sub_unroll_self_of_bridges : forall (A B : typ),
  sub nil (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B) ->
  (sub nil (open_tt A (typ_mu A)) (open_tt A (typ_mu B)) \/
   sub nil (open_tt B (typ_mu A)) (open_tt B (typ_mu B))) ->
  sub nil (open_tt A (typ_mu A)) (open_tt B (typ_mu B)).
Proof.
  intros A B H [HA|HB].
  - eapply sub_unroll_self_nil_of_bridge_A; eauto.
  - eapply sub_unroll_self_nil_of_bridge_B; eauto.
Qed.

Require Export Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_nat : typ
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : var -> typ
  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_mu : typ -> typ
  | typ_label : var -> typ -> typ
  | typ_rcd_nil : typ
  | typ_rcd_cons : var -> typ -> typ -> typ
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_nat : exp
  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_nil : exp
  | exp_rcd_cons : var -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_proj : exp -> var -> exp
.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
  | typ_top         => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (open_tt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_label l T        => typ_label l (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Inductive rt_type : typ -> Prop :=
  | rt_type_rcd_nil :
      rt_type typ_rcd_nil
  | rt_type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      rt_type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_nat :
      type typ_nat
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_mu : forall L T,
      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_mu T)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_label: forall l A,
      type A ->
      type (typ_label l A)
  | type_rcd_nil :
      type typ_rcd_nil
  | type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2).

Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_label l T => typ_label l (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_label l T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => fv_tt T1 \u fv_tt T2
  end.

Inductive binding : Set :=
| bind_sub : typ -> binding
| bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Fixpoint Tlookup (i':var) (Tr:typ) : option typ :=
  match Tr with
  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) =>
      if i == i' then Some T1 else Tlookup i' T2
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint collectLabel (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) => {{i}} \u collectLabel T2
  | _ => {}
  end.

Fixpoint collectLabele (e: exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) => {{i}} \u collectLabele e2
  | _ => {}
  end.

Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_var: forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      WF E (typ_all T1 T2)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A)
| WF_label: forall E A X,
    WF E A ->
    WF E (typ_label X A)
| WF_rcd_nil : forall E,
      WF E typ_rcd_nil
| WF_rcd_cons : forall E i T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      WF E T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabel T2) ->
      WF E (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

  - symmetry in E. subst Y. destruct (X == X) as [E2|E2]; [reflexivity|contradiction].

Lemma swa_other : forall X Y Z, Z <> X -> Z <> Y -> swa X Y Z = Z.
Proof.

  destruct (Z == X) as [E|E]; [exfalso; apply HX; symmetry; exact E|].
  destruct (Z == Y) as [E|E]; [exfalso; apply HY; symmetry; exact E|reflexivity].

Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_var: forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      WF E (typ_all T1 T2)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A)
| WF_label: forall E A X,
    WF E A ->
    WF E (typ_label X A)
| WF_rcd_nil : forall E,
      WF E typ_rcd_nil
| WF_rcd_cons : forall E i T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      WF E T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabel T2) ->
      WF E (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Fixpoint fl_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) `union` (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fl_tt T)
  | typ_label X T => {{ X }} `union` fl_tt T
Inductive rt_type : typ -> Prop :=
  | rt_type_rcd_nil :
      rt_type typ_rcd_nil
  | rt_type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      rt_type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_nat :
      type typ_nat
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_mu : forall L T,
      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_mu T)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_label: forall l A,
      type A ->
      type (typ_label l A)
  | type_rcd_nil :
      type typ_rcd_nil
  | type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2).

Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)

Require Import Rules.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.

Lemma sub_label_inv : forall E X Y A B,
  sub E (typ_label X A) (typ_label Y B) ->
  X = Y /\ sub E A B.
Proof.
  intros E X Y A B H.
  inversion H; subst; eauto.
  exfalso.
  match goal with
  | Hr : rt_type (typ_label _ _) |- _ => inversion Hr
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_nat |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_fvar _ |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_mu _ |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_arrow _ _ |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_all _ _ |- _ => discriminate He
  end.
Qed.

Lemma first_blocking_arrow_bvar :
  forall A2 B2,
    sub nil (typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) A2))
            (typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) B2)) ->
    True.

  intros A2 B2 H.

  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tt A2 \u fv_tt B2 \u fl_tt A2 \u fl_tt B2)) as [X HX].

  pose proof (HK X Hnotin) as K.

  Show.

    + subst X. rewrite erase_fvar_eq.

Lemma kernel_unroll : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (A B : typ),
  wf_env E ->
  X \notin dom E ->
  X \notin fv_env E ->
  X \notin fl_env E ->
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  X \notin fl_tt A ->
  X \notin fv_tt B ->
  X \notin fl_tt B ->
  sub (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)
      (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))
      (open_tt B (typ_label X (open_tt B X))) ->
  forall W, WF nil W -> sub E (open_tt A W) (open_tt B W).
Proof.
  intros E X A B Hwe HXd HXfvE HXflE HXfvA HXflA HXfvB HXflB HK W Hwnil.
  assert (HweX : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)).
  { apply wf_env_sub.
    - exact Hwe.
    - apply WF_top.
    - exact HXd. }
  assert (HbX : binds X (bind_sub typ_top) (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)).
  { simpl. left. reflexivity. }
  pose proof (@sub_erase (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) HweX X HbX
     (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))
     (open_tt B (typ_label X (open_tt B X))) HK W Hwnil) as Hres.
  assert (Heenv : erase_env X W (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) = E).
  { change (erase_env X W ((X, bind_sub typ_top) :: E) = E).
    rewrite erase_env_cons_eq with (Y := X) (b := bind_sub typ_top) (E := E)
      by reflexivity.
    apply erase_env_id; assumption. }
  rewrite Heenv in Hres.
  unfold open_tt in Hres.
  rewrite (@erase_open X W 0 (typ_label X (open_tt_rec 0 X A)) A
             (wf_lc_tt Hwnil)) in Hres.
  rewrite (@erase_open X W 0 (typ_label X (open_tt_rec 0 X B)) B
             (wf_lc_tt Hwnil)) in Hres.
  rewrite erase_label_eq in Hres.
  rewrite erase_label_eq in Hres.
  rewrite (@erase_id X W A HXfvA HXflA) in Hres.
  rewrite (@erase_id X W B HXfvB HXflB) in Hres.
  unfold open_tt in *. exact Hres.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 3.  Same-argument unrolling for an arbitrary env,        *)
(* directly from the hypothesis  sub E (mu A) (mu B).           *)
(* This generalises Task.v's sub_unroll_same and is the piece    *)
(* that discharges every component in which the recursive        *)
(* variable is absent / when a closed W can be used.             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma sub_unroll_same_E : forall (E : env) (A B : typ),
  wf_env E ->
  sub E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B) ->
  forall W, WF nil W -> sub E (open_tt A W) (open_tt B W).
Proof.
  intros E A B Hwe H W Hwnil.
  destruct (sub_mu_inv H) as [L [HwfA [HwfB HK]]].
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u dom E \u fv_env E \u fl_env E
                          \u fv_tt A \u fl_tt A \u fv_tt B \u fl_tt B))
    as [X HX].
  assert (HXL : X \notin L) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXd : X \notin dom E) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXfvE : X \notin fv_env E) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXflE : X \notin fl_env E) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXfvA : X \notin fv_tt A) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXflA : X \notin fl_tt A) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXfvB : X \notin fv_tt B) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXflB : X \notin fl_tt B) by fsetdec.
  eapply kernel_unroll; eauto.
Qed.

Fixpoint erase (X : atom) (W : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar i => typ_bvar i
  | typ_fvar Y => if Y == X then W else typ_fvar Y
  | typ_arrow A B => typ_arrow (erase X W A) (erase X W B)
  | typ_all A B => typ_all (erase X W A) (erase X W B)
  | typ_mu A => typ_mu (erase X W A)
  | typ_label Y A => if Y == X then W else typ_label Y (erase X W A)
  | typ_rcd_nil => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i A B => typ_rcd_cons i (erase X W A) (erase X W B)
  end.

Definition erase_binding X W b :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (erase X W T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (erase X W T)
  end.

Fixpoint erase_env X W E {struct E} : env :=
  match E with
  | nil => nil
  | (Y, b) :: E' =>
      if Y == X then erase_env X W E'
      else (Y, erase_binding X W b) :: erase_env X W E'
  end.

Lemma lc_tt_open_any_gen : forall k T, lc_tt k T ->
  forall K (L : typ), k <= K -> open_tt_rec K L T = T.
Proof.
  intros k T. revert k. induction T; intros k Hc K L Hle; simpl in *; try reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; [exfalso; lia|reflexivity].
  - (* arrow *) destruct Hc as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHT1 k H1 K L Hle), (IHT2 k H2 K L Hle). reflexivity.
  - (* all *) destruct Hc as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHT1 k H1 K L Hle), (IHT2 (S k) H2 (S K) L (le_n_S k K Hle)). reflexivity.
  - (* mu *) apply f_equal. apply (IHT (S k) Hc (S K) L (le_n_S k K Hle)).
  - (* label *) apply f_equal. apply (IHT k Hc K L Hle).
  - (* rcd_cons *) destruct Hc as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHT1 k H1 K L Hle), (IHT2 k H2 K L Hle). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lc_tt_open_any : forall T, lc_tt 0 T ->
  forall K (L : typ), open_tt_rec K L T = T.
Proof. intros. apply (@lc_tt_open_any_gen 0 T H K L). lia. Qed.

Lemma erase_id : forall X W T,
  X \notin fv_tt T -> X \notin fl_tt T -> erase X W T = T.
Proof.
  intros X W T. induction T; simpl; intros Hfv Hfl; try reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) destruct (a == X) as [E|E].
    + exfalso. apply Hfv. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. exact E.
    + simpl. reflexivity.
  - (* arrow *) apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as Hf1; apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as Hf2.
    apply notin_union_1 in Hfl as Hg1; apply notin_union_2 in Hfl as Hg2.
    rewrite (IHT1 Hf1 Hg1), (IHT2 Hf2 Hg2). reflexivity.
  - (* all *) apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as Hf1; apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as Hf2.
    apply notin_union_1 in Hfl as Hg1; apply notin_union_2 in Hfl as Hg2.
    rewrite (IHT1 Hf1 Hg1), (IHT2 Hf2 Hg2). reflexivity.
  - (* mu *) rewrite (IHT Hfv Hfl). reflexivity.
  - (* label *) destruct (a == X) as [E|E].
    + exfalso. apply notin_union_1 in Hfl as Hg1. exact (notin_singleton_1 a X Hg1 E).
    + apply notin_union_2 in Hfl as Hg2. simpl. rewrite (IHT Hfv Hg2). reflexivity.
  - (* rcd_cons *) apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as Hf1; apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as Hf2.
    apply notin_union_2 in Hfl as Hgtail.
    apply notin_union_1 in Hgtail as Hg1; apply notin_union_2 in Hgtail as Hg2.
    rewrite (IHT1 Hf1 Hg1), (IHT2 Hf2 Hg2). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma erase_open : forall X W K L T,
  lc_tt 0 W ->
  erase X W (open_tt_rec K L T) = open_tt_rec K (erase X W L) (erase X W T).
Proof.
  intros X W K L T Hc. revert K. induction T; simpl; intros K; try reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (K === n); simpl; reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) destruct (a == X) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + symmetry. apply lc_tt_open_any. exact Hc.
    + reflexivity.
  - (* arrow *) rewrite (IHT1 K), (IHT2 K). reflexivity.
  - (* all *) rewrite (IHT1 K), (IHT2 (S K)). reflexivity.
  - (* mu *) rewrite (IHT (S K)); reflexivity.
  - (* label *) destruct (a == X) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + symmetry. apply lc_tt_open_any. exact Hc.
    + rewrite IHT; reflexivity.
  - (* rcd_cons *) rewrite (IHT1 K), (IHT2 K). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma erase_env_cons_eq : forall X W (Y : atom) b E,

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
  | typ_top         => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (open_tt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_label l T        => typ_label l (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_var: forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      WF E (typ_all T1 T2)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A)
| WF_label: forall E A X,
    WF E A ->
    WF E (typ_label X A)
| WF_rcd_nil : forall E,
      WF E typ_rcd_nil
| WF_rcd_cons : forall E i T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      WF E T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabel T2) ->
      WF E (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Fixpoint fl_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) `union` (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fl_tt T)
  | typ_label X T => {{ X }} `union` fl_tt T
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) \u (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => {{i}} \u fl_tt T1 \u fl_tt T2
  end.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Not-in preservation under renaming                            *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma fv_tt_rename_notin : forall T f Z,
  (forall A B, f A = f B -> A = B) ->
  Z \notin fv_tt T -> f Z \notin fv_tt (rename_tt f T).
Proof.
  intros T f Z Hinj H Hc.
  destruct (@fv_tt_rename_out T f (f Z) Hc) as [W [HW HE]].
  apply Hinj in HE. subst W. contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma fl_tt_rename_notin : forall T f Z,
  (forall A B, f A = f B -> A = B) ->
  Z \notin fl_tt T -> f Z \notin fl_tt (rename_tt f T).
Proof.
  intros T f Z Hinj H Hc.
  destruct (@fl_tt_rename_out T f (f Z) Hc) as [W [HW HE]].
  apply Hinj in HE. subst W. contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma dom_rename_notin : forall E f Z,
  (forall A B, f A = f B -> A = B) ->
  Z \notin dom E -> f Z \notin dom (rename_env f E).
Proof.
  intros E f Z Hinj H Hc.

Lemma fv_env_rename_notin : forall E f Z,

  Z \notin fv_env E -> f Z \notin fv_env (rename_env f E).

  destruct (@fv_env_rename_out E f (f Z) Hc) as [W [HW HE]].
  apply Hinj in HE. subst W. contradiction.

Lemma fl_env_rename_notin : forall E f Z,

Fixpoint collectLabele (e: exp) : atoms :=

Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_var: forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      WF E (typ_all T1 T2)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A)
| WF_label: forall E A X,
    WF E A ->
    WF E (typ_label X A)
| WF_rcd_nil : forall E,
      WF E typ_rcd_nil
| WF_rcd_cons : forall E i T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      WF E T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabel T2) ->
      WF E (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Fixpoint fl_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) `union` (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fl_tt T)
  | typ_label X T => {{ X }} `union` fl_tt T
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) \u (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => {{i}} \u fl_tt T1 \u fl_tt T2
  end.

Fixpoint fv_env (E:env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')

Lemma sub_erase : forall E, wf_env E -> forall Xs,
  binds Xs (bind_sub typ_top) E ->
  forall A B, sub E A B ->
  forall Wt, WF nil Wt ->
  sub (erase_env Xs Wt E) (erase Xs Wt A) (erase Xs Wt B).
Proof.
  intros E Hwe Xs Hb A B H. induction H; intros Wt Hwnil.
  - (* nat *) simpl. apply sa_nat. apply (@wf_env_erase E Hwe Xs Wt Hwnil).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sa_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub E typ_nat typ_nat
| sa_fvar: forall E X,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E (typ_fvar X) ->
    sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sa_top : forall E A,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E A ->
    sub E A typ_top
| sa_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
| sa_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub E B1 A1 ->
    sub E A2 B2 ->
    sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sa_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
    sub E S1 S2 ->
    sub E S2 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2)
| sa_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A2 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        sub (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 (typ_label X (open_tt A1 X))) (open_tt A2 (typ_label X (open_tt A2 X)))) ->
    sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)
| sa_label: forall E X A B,
    sub E A B ->
    sub E (typ_label X A) (typ_label X B)
| sa_rcd: forall A1 A2 E,
    wf_env E ->
    rt_type A1 ->
    rt_type A2 ->
    collectLabel A2 [<=] collectLabel A1 ->
    WF E A1 -> WF E A2 ->
    (forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A1 = Some t1 ->  Tlookup i A2 = Some t2 -> sub E t1 t2) ->
    sub E A1 A2
.

Lemma sub_label_inv : forall E X Y A B,
  sub E (typ_label X A) (typ_label Y B) ->
  X = Y /\ sub E A B.
Proof.
  intros E X Y A B H.
  inversion H; subst; eauto.
  exfalso.
  match goal with
  | Hr : rt_type (typ_label _ _) |- _ => inversion Hr
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_nat |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_fvar _ |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_mu _ |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_arrow _ _ |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_all _ _ |- _ => discriminate He
  end.
Qed.

(* If A = arrow (bvar 0) A2 and B = arrow (bvar 0) B2, then the
   target for this pair is EXACTLY the pair (reverse mu subtyping,
   mixed codomain subtyping).  The reverse-mu component is the
   first obligation that cannot be discharged by
   sub_unroll_same_E / erase alone.  Fully proved (no Admitted). *)
Lemma sub_unroll_self_nil_arrow_bvar0_iff : forall (A2 B2 : typ),
  sub nil
    (open_tt (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) A2) (typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) A2)))
    (open_tt (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) B2) (typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) B2)))
  <->
  sub nil (typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) B2))
          (typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) A2)) /\
  sub nil (open_tt A2 (typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) A2)))
          (open_tt B2 (typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) B2))).
Proof.
  intros A2 B2. split.
  - intros Ht. unfold open_tt in Ht. simpl in Ht.
    apply sub_arrow_inv in Ht as [Hdom Hcod].
    split; assumption.
  - intros [Hdom Hcod]. unfold open_tt. simpl.
    apply sa_arrow; assumption.
Qed.

(* UA<:UB / UB<:UA.                                              *)

Definition four (E : env) (C D Y UA UB : typ) : Prop :=
  sub E (open_tt C Y) (open_tt D Y) /\
  sub E (open_tt D Y) (open_tt C Y) /\
  sub E (open_tt C UA) (open_tt D UB) /\
  sub E (open_tt D UB) (open_tt C UA).

Lemma four_arrow_decomp : forall E C1 C2 D1 D2 Y UA UB,
  four E (typ_arrow C1 C2) (typ_arrow D1 D2) Y UA UB <->
  four E C1 D1 Y UA UB /\ four E C2 D2 Y UA UB.
Proof.
  intros E C1 C2 D1 D2 Y UA UB.
  unfold four. unfold open_tt. simpl.
  split.
  - intros (H1 & H2 & H3 & H4).

    apply sub_arrow_inv in H2 as [H2d H2c].
    apply sub_arrow_inv in H3 as [H3d H3c].
    apply sub_arrow_inv in H4 as [H4d H4c].
    split.

    + repeat split; assumption.
  - intros [[F1 R1 M1 N1] [F2 R2 M2 N2]].

  sub E Y Y /\ sub E UA UB /\ sub E UB UA.
Proof.

  split.
  - intros (H1 & H2 & H3 & H4). repeat split; assumption.
  - intros (H1 & H3 & H4). repeat split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma rename_env_eq : forall E f,
  (forall X, X \in dom E -> f X = X) ->
  (forall X, X \in fv_env E -> f X = X) ->
  (forall X, X \in fl_env E -> f X = X) ->
  rename_env f E = E.

  induction E as [| hd tl IH].
  - intros f Hd Hfv Hfl. reflexivity.
  - intros f Hd Hfv Hfl. destruct hd as [y b]. destruct b; simpl in *.
    + assert (Hy : f y = y) by (apply Hd; simpl; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; reflexivity).
      assert (Hb : rename_tt f t = t).
      { apply @rename_tt_eq.
        - intros Z HZ. apply Hfv. apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact HZ.
        - intros Z HZ. apply Hfl. apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact HZ. }
      rewrite Hy, Hb. f_equal. apply IH.
      * intros Z HZ. apply Hd. simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. exact HZ.
      * intros Z HZ. apply Hfv. apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. exact HZ.
      * intros Z HZ. apply Hfl. apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. exact HZ.
    + assert (Hy : f y = y) by (apply Hd; simpl; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; reflexivity).
      assert (Hb : rename_tt f t = t).

      * intros Z HZ. apply Hd. simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. exact HZ.
      * intros Z HZ. apply Hfv. apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. exact HZ.

Require Import A3.Prelude.
Require Import Rules.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import A3.Lemmas.

Definition R1 (i j:atom) := typ_rcd_cons i typ_top (typ_rcd_cons j (typ_bvar 0) typ_rcd_nil).
Definition R2 (i j:atom) := typ_rcd_cons j (typ_bvar 0) (typ_rcd_cons i typ_top typ_rcd_nil).

Lemma top_refl : forall E, wf_env E -> sub E typ_top typ_top.
Proof. intros. apply sub_refl; [exact H|apply WF_top]. Qed.

Lemma R12_lookup_fwd : forall i j E U V,
  i <> j -> wf_env E -> sub E U V ->
  forall k t1 t2,
    Tlookup k (typ_rcd_cons i typ_top (typ_rcd_cons j U typ_rcd_nil)) = Some t1 ->
    Tlookup k (typ_rcd_cons j V (typ_rcd_cons i typ_top typ_rcd_nil)) = Some t2 ->
    sub E t1 t2.
Proof.
  intros i j E U V Hij Hwe HUV k t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (i == k) as [Hik|Hik] eqn:Eik.
  - subst k.
    destruct (j == i) as [Hji|Hji] eqn:Eji.
    + exfalso. apply Hij. symmetry. exact Hji.
    + try rewrite Eik in H1; try rewrite Eik in H2;
      try rewrite Eji in H1; try rewrite Eji in H2;
      simpl in H1; simpl in H2.
      injection H1 as Ht1. injection H2 as Ht2. subst t1. subst t2.
      apply top_refl. exact Hwe.
  - destruct (j == k) as [Hjk|Hjk] eqn:Ejk.
    + subst k.
      destruct (i == j) as [Hij'|Hij'] eqn:Eij.
      * exfalso. apply Hij. exact Hij'.
      * try rewrite Eik in H1; try rewrite Eik in H2;
        try rewrite Ejk in H1; try rewrite Ejk in H2;
        try rewrite Eij in H1; try rewrite Eij in H2;
        simpl in H1; simpl in H2.
        injection H1 as Ht1. injection H2 as Ht2. subst t1. subst t2.
        exact HUV.
    + try rewrite Eik in H1; try rewrite Eik in H2;
      try rewrite Ejk in H1; try rewrite Ejk in H2; simpl in H1; simpl in H2.
      discriminate H1.
Qed.

Lemma R12_lookup_bwd : forall i j E U V,
  i <> j -> wf_env E -> sub E V U ->
  forall k t1 t2,
    Tlookup k (typ_rcd_cons j V (typ_rcd_cons i typ_top typ_rcd_nil)) = Some t1 ->
    Tlookup k (typ_rcd_cons i typ_top (typ_rcd_cons j U typ_rcd_nil)) = Some t2 ->
    sub E t1 t2.
Proof.

Lemma sub_arrow_inv : forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
  sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2) -> sub E B1 A1 /\ sub E A2 B2.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst; auto;
  try (exfalso; match goal with
       | Hr : rt_type (typ_arrow _ _) |- _ => inversion Hr
       | He : typ_arrow _ _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate He
       | He : typ_arrow _ _ = typ_fvar _ |- _ => discriminate He
       end).

Lemma sub_all_inv : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
  sub E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) ->
  exists L, sub E S1 S2 /\ sub E S2 S1 /\
    (forall X, X \notin L -> sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)).

  intros. inversion H; subst; eauto;
  try (exfalso; match goal with
       | Hr : rt_type (typ_all _ _) |- _ => inversion Hr
       | He : typ_all _ _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate He

       end).

Lemma sub_mu_inv : forall E A1 A2,

        (open_tt A1 (typ_label X (open_tt A1 X)))
