Require Import Rules.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.

Lemma subst_tt_fvar_eq : forall X U, subst_tt X U (typ_fvar X) = U.
Proof. intros. simpl. destruct (X == X); [reflexivity|contradiction]. Qed.

Lemma subst_tt_fvar_neq : forall X Y U, X <> Y -> subst_tt X U (typ_fvar Y) = typ_fvar Y.
Proof. intros. simpl. destruct (Y == X) as [E|E]; [exfalso; apply H; symmetry; exact E | reflexivity]. Qed.

Lemma subst_tt_open_tt_rec_diff : forall X U K Y T,
  X <> Y -> X \notin fv_tt T ->
  subst_tt X U (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) T) = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) (subst_tt X U T).
Proof.
  intros X U K Y T Hneq Hfv.
  generalize dependent K.
  induction T; intros K; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (K === n); [ apply subst_tt_fvar_neq; auto | reflexivity ].
  - (* fvar a: Hfv : a \notin {{X}}? actually fv_tt (fvar a) = {{a}}; H : X \notin {{a}} *)
    apply notin_singleton_1 in Hfv. simpl. destruct (a == X) as [E|E].
    + exfalso. exact (Hfv E).
    + reflexivity.
  - (* arrow *) apply notin_union_1 in Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_2 in Hfv as H2.

Require Export Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_nat : typ
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : var -> typ
  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_mu : typ -> typ
  | typ_label : var -> typ -> typ
  | typ_rcd_nil : typ
  | typ_rcd_cons : var -> typ -> typ -> typ
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_nat : exp
  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_nil : exp
  | exp_rcd_cons : var -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_proj : exp -> var -> exp
.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
  | typ_top         => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (open_tt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_label l T        => typ_label l (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sa_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub E typ_nat typ_nat
| sa_fvar: forall E X,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E (typ_fvar X) ->
    sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sa_top : forall E A,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E A ->
    sub E A typ_top
| sa_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
| sa_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub E B1 A1 ->
    sub E A2 B2 ->
    sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sa_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
    sub E S1 S2 ->
    sub E S2 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2)
| sa_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A2 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        sub (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 (typ_label X (open_tt A1 X))) (open_tt A2 (typ_label X (open_tt A2 X)))) ->
    sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)
| sa_label: forall E X A B,
    sub E A B ->
    sub E (typ_label X A) (typ_label X B)
| sa_rcd: forall A1 A2 E,
    wf_env E ->
    rt_type A1 ->
    rt_type A2 ->
    collectLabel A2 [<=] collectLabel A1 ->
    WF E A1 -> WF E A2 ->
    (forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A1 = Some t1 ->  Tlookup i A2 = Some t2 -> sub E t1 t2) ->
    sub E A1 A2
.

Definition subst_tb (Z : atom) (P : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tt Z P T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tt Z P T)
  end.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_te_rec K U e1) i
  end.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_ee_rec k f e1) i
  end.

Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.

Definition open_ee e1 e2 := open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1.

Inductive rt_expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | rt_expr_rcd_nil :
      rt_expr exp_rcd_nil
  | rt_expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
      rt_expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | expr_nat : expr exp_nat
  | expr_var : forall x,
      expr (exp_fvar x)
  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1)
  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
  | expr_tabs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_tabs T e1)
  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
      expr e1 ->
      type V ->
      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
  | expr_unfold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_unfold T e)
  | expr_fold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_fold T e)
  | expr_rcd_nil :
     expr exp_rcd_nil
  | expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
     expr e1 ->
     expr e2 ->
     rt_expr e2 ->
     expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
  | expr_rcd_proj : forall i e,
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_rcd_proj e i)
.

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Fixpoint tlookup (i':var) (Er:exp) : option exp :=
  match Er with
  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) =>
      if i == i' then Some e1 else tlookup i' e2
  | _ => None
  end.

Inductive typing : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_nat: forall G,
    wf_env G ->
    typing G (exp_nat) (typ_nat)
  | typing_var : forall E x T,
      wf_env E ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E e1 e2 T2,
      typing E e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E e2 T1 ->
      typing E (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E e1 T T2,
      typing E e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_fold : forall G A T e ,
      sub G (typ_mu A) T ->
      typing G e (open_tt A T)  ->
      typing G (exp_fold T e) T
  | typing_unfold : forall G A T e,
     typing G e A -> sub G A (typ_mu T) ->
     typing G (exp_unfold A e)  (open_tt T A)
  | typing_sub : forall S E e T,
      typing E e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E e T
  | typing_proj : forall G e T i Ti,
      typing G e T ->
      Tlookup i T = Some Ti ->
      typing G (exp_rcd_proj e i) Ti
  | typing_rcd_nil : forall G,
      wf_env G ->
      typing G exp_rcd_nil typ_rcd_nil
  | typing_rcd_cons: forall G e1 e2 T1 T2 i,
      typing G e1 T1 ->
      typing G e2 T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      rt_expr e2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabele e2) ->
      typing G (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall t1 T,
      expr (exp_abs T t1) ->
      value (exp_abs T t1)
  | value_tabs : forall t1 T,
      expr (exp_tabs T t1) ->
      value (exp_tabs T t1)
  | value_nat:

  | value_fold: forall T e,
      type T ->

      value (exp_fold T e)
  | value_rcd_nil:
      value exp_rcd_nil
 | value_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
      value e1 ->
      value e2 ->
      rt_expr e2 ->
      value (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
.

  match e with
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_bvar i => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {}
  | exp_abs V e1  => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)

  E = nil -> forall x y V, e = exp_tapp x V ->
  (forall A1 A2, typing nil x (typ_all A1 A2) -> typing nil y (typ_all A1 A2)) ->
  typing nil (exp_tapp y V) T.
Proof.
  intros E e T H. induction H; intros Enil x0 y0 V0 Ee Hstep.
  - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee.
  - (* tabs case subject mismatch *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* tapp *) injection Ee as Hx HV. subst x0. subst V0. subst E.
    simpl. eapply typing_tapp.
    + apply Hstep. exact H.
    + exact H0.
  - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee.
  - (* sub *) subst E. eapply typing_sub.
    + apply (IHtyping eq_refl x0 y0 V0 Ee Hstep).
    + exact H0.
  - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee.
Qed.

Lemma typing_tapp_step : forall x y V T,
  typing nil (exp_tapp x V) T ->
  (forall A1 A2, typing nil x (typ_all A1 A2) -> typing nil y (typ_all A1 A2)) ->
  typing nil (exp_tapp y V) T.

  E = nil -> forall F x0 y0, e = exp_fold F x0 ->
  (forall A, typing nil x0 A -> typing nil y0 A) ->
  typing nil (exp_fold F y0) T.
Proof.
  intros E e T H. induction H; intros Enil F x0 y0 Ee Hstep.
  - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee. - discriminate Ee.
  - (* fold *) injection Ee as HT He. subst F. subst x0. subst G.
    simpl. eapply typing_fold.
    + exact H.
    + apply Hstep. exact H0.
  - discriminate Ee.
  - (* sub *) subst E. eapply typing_sub.
    + apply (IHtyping eq_refl F x0 y0 Ee Hstep).

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 2.  Kernel unrolling with a fresh knot variable X:       *)
(* erasing the knot by ANY closed W gives the same-argument      *)
(* unrolling of an arbitrary kernel derivation.                  *)
(* This is exactly the tool suggested by the coordinator's hint: *)
(* it applies to arrow/label subderivations too, not only to the *)
(* top-level kernel.                                             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma kernel_unroll : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (A B : typ),
  wf_env E ->
  X \notin dom E ->
  X \notin fv_env E ->
  X \notin fl_env E ->
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  X \notin fl_tt A ->
  X \notin fv_tt B ->
  X \notin fl_tt B ->
  sub (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)
      (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))
      (open_tt B (typ_label X (open_tt B X))) ->
  forall W, WF nil W -> sub E (open_tt A W) (open_tt B W).
Proof.
  intros E X A B Hwe HXd HXfvE HXflE HXfvA HXflA HXfvB HXflB HK W Hwnil.
  assert (HweX : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)).
  { apply wf_env_sub.
    - exact Hwe.
    - apply WF_top.
    - exact HXd. }
  assert (HbX : binds X (bind_sub typ_top) (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)).
  { simpl. left. reflexivity. }
  pose proof (@sub_erase (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) HweX X HbX
     (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))
     (open_tt B (typ_label X (open_tt B X))) HK W Hwnil) as Hres.
  assert (Heenv : erase_env X W (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) = E).
  { change (erase_env X W ((X, bind_sub typ_top) :: E) = E).
    rewrite erase_env_cons_eq with (Y := X) (b := bind_sub typ_top) (E := E)
      by reflexivity.
    apply erase_env_id; assumption. }
  rewrite Heenv in Hres.
  unfold open_tt in Hres.
  rewrite (@erase_open X W 0 (typ_label X (open_tt_rec 0 X A)) A
             (wf_lc_tt Hwnil)) in Hres.
  rewrite (@erase_open X W 0 (typ_label X (open_tt_rec 0 X B)) B
             (wf_lc_tt Hwnil)) in Hres.
  rewrite erase_label_eq in Hres.
  rewrite erase_label_eq in Hres.
  rewrite (@erase_id X W A HXfvA HXflA) in Hres.
  rewrite (@erase_id X W B HXfvB HXflB) in Hres.
  unfold open_tt in *. exact Hres.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 3.  Same-argument unrolling for an arbitrary env,        *)
(* directly from the hypothesis  sub E (mu A) (mu B).           *)
(* This generalises Task.v's sub_unroll_same and is the piece    *)
(* that discharges every component in which the recursive        *)
(* variable is absent / when a closed W can be used.             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma sub_unroll_same_E : forall (E : env) (A B : typ),
  wf_env E ->
  sub E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B) ->
  forall W, WF nil W -> sub E (open_tt A W) (open_tt B W).
Proof.
  intros E A B Hwe H W Hwnil.
  destruct (sub_mu_inv H) as [L [HwfA [HwfB HK]]].
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u dom E \u fv_env E \u fl_env E
                          \u fv_tt A \u fl_tt A \u fv_tt B \u fl_tt B))
    as [X HX].
  assert (HXL : X \notin L) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXd : X \notin dom E) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXfvE : X \notin fv_env E) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXflE : X \notin fl_env E) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXfvA : X \notin fv_tt A) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXflA : X \notin fl_tt A) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXfvB : X \notin fv_tt B) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXflB : X \notin fl_tt B) by fsetdec.
  eapply kernel_unroll; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma sub_label_inv : forall E X Y A B,
  sub E (typ_label X A) (typ_label Y B) ->
  X = Y /\ sub E A B.
Proof.
  intros E X Y A B H.
  inversion H; subst; eauto.
  exfalso.
  match goal with
  | Hr : rt_type (typ_label _ _) |- _ => inversion Hr
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_nat |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_fvar _ |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_mu _ |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_arrow _ _ |- _ => discriminate He
  | He : typ_label _ _ = typ_all _ _ |- _ => discriminate He
  end.
Qed.

(* If A = arrow (bvar 0) A2 and B = arrow (bvar 0) B2, then the
   target for this pair is EXACTLY the pair (reverse mu subtyping,
   mixed codomain subtyping).  The reverse-mu component is the
   first obligation that cannot be discharged by
   sub_unroll_same_E / erase alone.  Fully proved (no Admitted). *)
Lemma sub_unroll_self_nil_arrow_bvar0_iff : forall (A2 B2 : typ),
  sub nil
    (open_tt (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) A2) (typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) A2)))
    (open_tt (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) B2) (typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) B2)))
  <->
  sub nil (typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) B2))
          (typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) A2)) /\
  sub nil (open_tt A2 (typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) A2)))
          (open_tt B2 (typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) B2))).
Proof.
  intros A2 B2. split.
  - intros Ht. unfold open_tt in Ht. simpl in Ht.
    apply sub_arrow_inv in Ht as [Hdom Hcod].
    split; assumption.
  - intros [Hdom Hcod]. unfold open_tt. simpl.
    apply sa_arrow; assumption.
Qed.

Definition four (E : env) (C D Y UA UB : typ) : Prop :=
  sub E (open_tt C Y) (open_tt D Y) /\
  sub E (open_tt D Y) (open_tt C Y) /\
  sub E (open_tt C UA) (open_tt D UB) /\
  sub E (open_tt D UB) (open_tt C UA).

Lemma four_arrow_decomp : forall E C1 C2 D1 D2 Y UA UB,
  four E (typ_arrow C1 C2) (typ_arrow D1 D2) Y UA UB <->
  four E C1 D1 Y UA UB /\ four E C2 D2 Y UA UB.
Proof.
  intros E C1 C2 D1 D2 Y UA UB.
  unfold four. unfold open_tt. simpl.
  split.
  - intros (H1 & H2 & H3 & H4).
    apply sub_arrow_inv in H1 as [H1d H1c].
    apply sub_arrow_inv in H2 as [H2d H2c].
    apply sub_arrow_inv in H3 as [H3d H3c].
    apply sub_arrow_inv in H4 as [H4d H4c].
    split.
    + repeat split; assumption.
    + repeat split; assumption.
  - intros [[F1 [R1 [M1 N1]]] [F2 [R2 [M2 N2]]]].
    repeat split; apply sa_arrow; assumption.
Qed.

(* At a hole pair the package degenerates exactly to the two    *)
(* argument relations.  The kernel supplies UB<:UA (K1), but    *)
(* never UA<:UB; the latter is equivalent to FS of the whole    *)
(* pair.  This is the irreducible coinductive/circular step.     *)
Lemma four_hole : forall E Y UA UB,
  four E (typ_bvar 0) (typ_bvar 0) Y UA UB <->
  sub E Y Y /\ sub E UA UB /\ sub E UB UA.
Proof.
  intros. unfold four. unfold open_tt. simpl.
  split.
  - intros (H1 & H2 & H3 & H4). repeat split; assumption.
  - intros (H1 & H3 & H4). repeat split; assumption.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 9.  Concrete record tool used by the composite-domain    *)
(* example: records with the same labels and pointwise subtyping *)
(* in both directions are mutually subtypes.  This is what       *)
(* closes RS/FM on reordered-record domains once the label       *)
(* forward relation D is available.                              *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma sub_rcd_mutual : forall E A1 A2,
  wf_env E ->
  rt_type A1 -> rt_type A2 ->
  WF E A1 -> WF E A2 ->
  collectLabel A1 [<=] collectLabel A2 ->
  collectLabel A2 [<=] collectLabel A1 ->
  (forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A1 = Some t1 -> Tlookup i A2 = Some t2 ->
      sub E t1 t2) ->
  (forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A2 = Some t1 -> Tlookup i A1 = Some t2 ->
      sub E t1 t2) ->
  sub E A1 A2 /\ sub E A2 A1.
Proof.
  intros E A1 A2 Hwe Hrt1 Hrt2 Hwf1 Hwf2 Hinc12 Hinc21 Hf12 Hf21.
  split.
  - eapply sa_rcd; eauto.
  - eapply sa_rcd; eauto.
Qed.

   - `A i j = arrow bvar0 (arrow (R1 i j) top)`, `B i j = arrow bvar0 (arrow (R2 i j) top)`, with the same record fields in different order.

   - No axioms used.

   - `sub_open_pos_rec`: monotonicity of opening in positive positions, fully proved, no axioms.

   - `arrow_bvar0_kernel_decomp` proves exactly what the hypothesis yields.

`/tmp/a3/revfail.v`, all assumptions closed:
- `A0 = arrow top nat`, `B0 = arrow nat top`.
- `H0 : sub nil (mu A0) (mu B0)` is proved.

`A = arrow bvar0 A2`, `B = arrow bvar0 B2`, `H : sub nil (mu A) (mu B)`, fresh `X`, `Gamma = X <: top ++ nil`,

- `K1d : sub Gamma X X`
- `K1e : sub Gamma (open B2 X) (open A2 X)`  (reverse same-argument)
- `K2  : sub Gamma (open A2 LA) (open B2 LB)` (forward mixed arguments)

This is formalized in `arrow_bvar0_kernel_decomp`.

To prove reverse mu `sub nil (mu B) (mu A)` at a fresh `Y`, one needs:
- `D : sub GammaY (open A2 Y) (open B2 Y)` (the forward same-argument fact, orientation opposite to `K1e`);
- `C : sub GammaY (open B2 (label Y (open B Y))) (open A2 (label Y (open A Y)))` (the reverse mixed fact, orientation opposite to `K2`).

`reverse_mu_arrow_bvar0_of_components` proves that `D`, `C`, and the WF families suffice. Deriving `D` and `C` from `K1e` and `K2` is the precise remaining gap; `K1e`/`K2` are at different arguments and opposite mixed orientations, and the concrete record-reordering instance shows this requires a context-equivalence argument.

Limited targeted searches found no counterexample: all 66 `(A2,B2)` pairs up to size 5 satisfying `H` had both reverse mu and the target; all 32 record-adjusted contexts up to size 5 satisfying the kernel conditions had the target. These were bounded-depth/size checks, not exhaustive proofs.

Lemma typing_abs_apply_gen : forall E e T, typing E e T ->
  E = nil -> forall V e1, e = exp_abs V e1 ->
  forall A1 A2, T = typ_arrow A1 A2 ->
  forall u, typing nil u A1 -> typing nil (open_ee e1 u) A2.
Proof.
  intros E e T H. induction H; intros Enil Vx ex Ee A1 A2 ET u Hu.
  - (* nat *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* var *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* abs *) injection Ee as HV He. injection ET as HA1 HA2.
    subst E. rewrite <- He. rewrite <- HA1 in Hu. rewrite <- HA2.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_ee e1 \u fv_ee u)) as [x Hx].
    assert (HxL : x \notin L) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hxe : x \notin fv_ee e1) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hxu : x \notin fv_ee u) by fsetdec.
    pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
    pose proof (typing_lc Hu) as HlcA.
    pose proof (typing_lc_exp Hu) as HlcE.
    assert (Hwen : wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ nil)) by (apply typing_wf_env in Hbody; exact Hbody).
    pose proof (typing_weaken_binds (E' := x ~ bind_typ V ++ nil) Hu Hwen
                  (fun Z b Hb => @binds_cons_any binding Z x b (bind_typ V) nil Hb)) as Hu'.
    pose proof (@typing_subst_ee_aux (x ~ bind_typ V ++ nil) (open_ee e1 x) T1 Hbody
                  x u V Hu' HlcA HlcE (binds_mid_typ nil nil x V)) as Hres.
    simpl in Hres.
    unfold open_ee in Hres.
    rewrite (@subst_ee_open_ee_same 0 x u e1 Hxe) in Hres.
    unfold open_ee in Hres |- *.
    eapply typing_remove_typ with (D:=nil) (E0:=nil) (z:=x) (W:=V).
    + exact Hres.
    + apply (@fv_ee_open_ee_exp 0 u e1 x Hxe Hxu).
  - (* app *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* tabs *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* tapp *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* fold *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* unfold *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* sub *) subst E. rewrite ET in H0.
    destruct (@sub_nil_arrow_inv S A1 A2 H0) as [B1 [B2 [Heq [Hdom Hcod]]]].
    assert (HuB1 : typing nil u B1) by (apply typing_sub with (S:=A1); assumption).
    pose proof (IHtyping eq_refl Vx ex Ee B1 B2 Heq u HuB1) as Hbody.
    simpl in Hbody.
    eapply typing_sub; [exact Hbody|exact Hcod].
  - (* proj *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* rcd_nil *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* rcd_cons *) discriminate Ee.
Qed.

Lemma typing_abs_apply_nil : forall V e1 U,
  typing nil (exp_abs V e1) U ->
  forall A1 A2, U = typ_arrow A1 A2 ->
  forall u, typing nil u A1 -> typing nil (open_ee e1 u) A2.
Proof.
  intros V e1 U H A1 A2 EU u Hu.
  exact (@typing_abs_apply_gen nil (exp_abs V e1) U H eq_refl V e1 eq_refl A1 A2 EU u Hu).
Qed.

Lemma preservation_beta : forall V e1 e2 A1 A2,
  typing nil (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow A1 A2) ->
  typing nil e2 A1 ->
  typing nil (open_ee e1 e2) A2.
Proof.
  intros V e1 e2 A1 A2 H Hu.
  exact (@typing_abs_apply_nil V e1 (typ_arrow A1 A2) H A1 A2 eq_refl e2 Hu).
Qed.

Lemma typing_app1_step_gen : forall E e T, typing E e T ->
  E = nil -> forall e1 e2 e1', e = exp_app e1 e2 ->
  (forall A1 A2, typing nil e1 (typ_arrow A1 A2) -> typing nil e1' (typ_arrow A1 A2)) ->
  typing nil (exp_app e1' e2) T.
Proof.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_nat :
      type typ_nat
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_mu : forall L T,
      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_mu T)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_label: forall l A,
      type A ->
      type (typ_label l A)
  | type_rcd_nil :
      type typ_rcd_nil
  | type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2).

Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_label l T => typ_label l (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_label l T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => fv_tt T1 \u fv_tt T2
  end.

Inductive binding : Set :=
| bind_sub : typ -> binding
| bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

    | L E A H1 IH1 H2 IH2

  - inversion Hin.

  end.

  In (i,t) l -> In t (pairs_with l i).
Proof.

    + injection Heq as Hi Ht. subst j. subst u. subst t.

    + destruct (i == j) as [e|e].

      * apply IH. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma pairs_with_in : forall l i t,
  In t (pairs_with l i) -> In (i,t) l.
Proof.
  induction l as [|[j u] rest IH]; intros i t H; simpl in *.

Lemma fold_typing_inv : forall F v S,
  typing nil (exp_fold F v) S ->
  exists A,
    sub nil (typ_mu A) F /\
    typing nil v (open_tt A F) /\
    sub nil F S.

Lemma sub_left_mu_or_top : forall E A T,
  sub E (typ_mu A) T -> T = typ_top \/ exists T1, T = typ_mu T1.
Proof.
  intros E A T H. inversion H; subst; eauto;
    try (exfalso; match goal with
         | Hr : rt_type (typ_mu _) |- _ => inversion Hr
         | He : typ_mu _ = typ_arrow _ _ |- _ => discriminate He
         | He : typ_mu _ = typ_all _ _ |- _ => discriminate He
         | He : typ_mu _ = typ_label _ _ |- _ => discriminate He
         | He : typ_mu _ = typ_fvar _ |- _ => discriminate He
         | He : typ_mu _ = typ_nat |- _ => discriminate He
         | He : typ_mu _ = typ_rcd_nil |- _ => discriminate He
         | He : typ_mu _ = typ_rcd_cons _ _ _ |- _ => discriminate He
         end).
Qed.

Lemma sub_nil_mu_left : forall T B,
  sub nil T (typ_mu B) -> exists F1, T = typ_mu F1.
Proof.
  intros T B H. dependent destruction H; eauto;
    try (exfalso; match goal with
         | H : binds _ (bind_sub _) nil |- _ => inversion H
         | H : rt_type (typ_mu _) |- _ => inversion H
         | H : typ_mu _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate H
         | H : typ_mu _ = typ_arrow _ _ |- _ => discriminate H
         | H : typ_mu _ = typ_all _ _ |- _ => discriminate H
         | H : typ_mu _ = typ_label _ _ |- _ => discriminate H
         | H : typ_mu _ = typ_fvar _ |- _ => discriminate H
         | H : typ_mu _ = typ_nat |- _ => discriminate H
         end).
Qed.

Lemma type_lc_tt : forall T, type T -> lc_tt 0 T.
Proof.
  intros T H. induction H.
  - (* top *) simpl. exact I.
  - (* nat *) simpl. exact I.
  - (* var *) simpl. exact I.
  - (* arrow *) simpl. split; assumption.
  - (* mu *) simpl.
    destruct (atom_fresh L) as [X HX].
    apply (@lc_tt_open_inv_same 0 X T).

  wf_env E ->
  X \notin dom E ->

  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  X \notin fl_tt A ->
  X \notin fv_tt B ->
  X \notin fl_tt B ->
  sub (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)
      (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))
      (open_tt B (typ_label X (open_tt B X))) ->

Lemma sub_unroll_same_E : forall (E : env) (A B : typ),
  wf_env E ->
  sub E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B) ->
  forall W, WF nil W -> sub E (open_tt A W) (open_tt B W).
Proof.
  intros E A B Hwe H W Hwnil.
  destruct (sub_mu_inv H) as [L [HwfA [HwfB HK]]].
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u dom E \u fv_env E \u fl_env E

Definition four (E : env) (C D Y UA UB : typ) : Prop :=
  sub E (open_tt C Y) (open_tt D Y) /\
  sub E (open_tt D Y) (open_tt C Y) /\
  sub E (open_tt C UA) (open_tt D UB) /\
  sub E (open_tt D UB) (open_tt C UA).

Lemma four_arrow_decomp : forall E C1 C2 D1 D2 Y UA UB,
  four E (typ_arrow C1 C2) (typ_arrow D1 D2) Y UA UB <->
  four E C1 D1 Y UA UB /\ four E C2 D2 Y UA UB.

  unfold four. unfold open_tt. simpl.

    apply sub_arrow_inv in H2 as [H2d H2c].
    apply sub_arrow_inv in H3 as [H3d H3c].
    apply sub_arrow_inv in H4 as [H4d H4c].
    split.
    + repeat split; assumption.
    + repeat split; assumption.
  - intros [[F1 [R1 [M1 N1]]] [F2 [R2 [M2 N2]]]].
    repeat split; apply sa_arrow; assumption.
Qed.

(* At a hole pair the package degenerates exactly to the two    *)
(* argument relations.  The kernel supplies UB<:UA (K1), but    *)
(* never UA<:UB; the latter is equivalent to FS of the whole    *)
(* pair.  This is the irreducible coinductive/circular step.     *)
Lemma four_hole : forall E Y UA UB,
  four E (typ_bvar 0) (typ_bvar 0) Y UA UB <->
  sub E Y Y /\ sub E UA UB /\ sub E UB UA.
Proof.
  intros. unfold four. unfold open_tt. simpl.
  split.
  - intros (H1 & H2 & H3 & H4). repeat split; assumption.
  - intros (H1 & H3 & H4). repeat split; assumption.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 9.  Concrete record tool used by the composite-domain    *)
(* example: records with the same labels and pointwise subtyping *)
(* in both directions are mutually subtypes.  This is what       *)
(* closes RS/FM on reordered-record domains once the label       *)
(* forward relation D is available.                              *)

Lemma sub_rcd_mutual : forall E A1 A2,
  wf_env E ->
  rt_type A1 -> rt_type A2 ->
  WF E A1 -> WF E A2 ->
  collectLabel A1 [<=] collectLabel A2 ->
  collectLabel A2 [<=] collectLabel A1 ->
  (forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A1 = Some t1 -> Tlookup i A2 = Some t2 ->
      sub E t1 t2) ->
  (forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A2 = Some t1 -> Tlookup i A1 = Some t2 ->
      sub E t1 t2) ->
  sub E A1 A2 /\ sub E A2 A1.
Proof.
  intros E A1 A2 Hwe Hrt1 Hrt2 Hwf1 Hwf2 Hinc12 Hinc21 Hf12 Hf21.
  split.
  - eapply sa_rcd; eauto.
  - eapply sa_rcd; eauto.
Qed.

(* Part 6: inversion principles for subtyping                  *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma sub_arrow_inv : forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
  sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2) -> sub E B1 A1 /\ sub E A2 B2.
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst; auto;
  try (exfalso; match goal with
       | Hr : rt_type (typ_arrow _ _) |- _ => inversion Hr
       | He : typ_arrow _ _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate He
       | He : typ_arrow _ _ = typ_fvar _ |- _ => discriminate He
       end).
Qed.

Lemma sub_all_inv : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
  sub E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) ->
  exists L, sub E S1 S2 /\ sub E S2 S1 /\
    (forall X, X \notin L -> sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)).
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst; eauto;
  try (exfalso; match goal with
       | Hr : rt_type (typ_all _ _) |- _ => inversion Hr
       | He : typ_all _ _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate He
       | He : typ_all _ _ = typ_fvar _ |- _ => discriminate He
       end).
Qed.

Lemma sub_mu_inv : forall E A1 A2,
  sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) ->
  exists L,
    (forall X, X \notin L -> WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 X)) /\
    (forall X, X \notin L -> WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A2 X)) /\
    (forall X, X \notin L -> sub (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)
        (open_tt A1 (typ_label X (open_tt A1 X)))
        (open_tt A2 (typ_label X (open_tt A2 X)))).
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst; eauto;
  try (exfalso; match goal with
       | Hr : rt_type (typ_mu _) |- _ => inversion Hr
       | He : typ_mu _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate He
       | He : typ_mu _ = typ_fvar _ |- _ => discriminate He
       end).
Qed.



(* ============================================================ *)
(* Part 7: typing weakening                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma binds_incl_cons_same : forall (X : atom) (b : binding) E E',
  (forall Z c, binds Z c E -> binds Z c E') ->
  forall Z c, binds Z c (X ~ b ++ E) -> binds Z c (X ~ b ++ E').
Proof.
  intros X b E E' Hinc Z c Hb.
  apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[Heq Hbeq]|Ht].
  - subst Z. subst c. simpl. left. reflexivity.
  - simpl. right. apply Hinc. exact Ht.
Qed.

Lemma typing_weaken_binds : forall E e T, typing E e T ->
  forall E', wf_env E' ->
  - (* fold *) rewrite (IHe j Hx). reflexivity.
  - (* rcd_nil *) reflexivity.
  - (* rcd_cons *) apply notin_union_1 in Hx as H1; apply notin_union_2 in Hx as H2.
    rewrite (IHe1 j H1), (IHe2 j H2). reflexivity.
  - (* rcd_proj *) rewrite (IHe j Hx). reflexivity.
Qed.


Lemma sub_nil_arrow_inv : forall X A1 A2,
  sub nil X (typ_arrow A1 A2) ->
  exists B1 B2, X = typ_arrow B1 B2 /\ sub nil A1 B1 /\ sub nil B2 A2.
Proof.
  intros X A1 A2 H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  - (* trans_tvar *) exfalso. inversion H0.
  - (* arrow *) eauto.
  - (* rcd *) exfalso. inversion H2.
Qed.

Lemma typing_abs_apply_gen : forall E e T, typing E e T ->
  E = nil -> forall V e1, e = exp_abs V e1 ->
  forall A1 A2, T = typ_arrow A1 A2 ->
  forall u, typing nil u A1 -> typing nil (open_ee e1 u) A2.
Proof.
  intros E e T H. induction H; intros Enil Vx ex Ee A1 A2 ET u Hu.
  - (* nat *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* var *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* abs *) injection Ee as HV He. injection ET as HA1 HA2.
    subst E. rewrite <- He. rewrite <- HA1 in Hu. rewrite <- HA2.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_ee e1 \u fv_ee u)) as [x Hx].
    assert (HxL : x \notin L) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hxe : x \notin fv_ee e1) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hxu : x \notin fv_ee u) by fsetdec.
    pose proof (H x HxL) as Hbody.
    pose proof (typing_lc Hu) as HlcA.
    pose proof (typing_lc_exp Hu) as HlcE.
    assert (Hwen : wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ nil)) by (apply typing_wf_env in Hbody; exact Hbody).
    pose proof (typing_weaken_binds (E' := x ~ bind_typ V ++ nil) Hu Hwen
                  (fun Z b Hb => @binds_cons_any binding Z x b (bind_typ V) nil Hb)) as Hu'.
    pose proof (@typing_subst_ee_aux (x ~ bind_typ V ++ nil) (open_ee e1 x) T1 Hbody
                  x u V Hu' HlcA HlcE (binds_mid_typ nil nil x V)) as Hres.
    simpl in Hres.
    unfold open_ee in Hres.
    rewrite (@subst_ee_open_ee_same 0 x u e1 Hxe) in Hres.
    unfold open_ee in Hres |- *.
    eapply typing_remove_typ with (D:=nil) (E0:=nil) (z:=x) (W:=V).
    + exact Hres.
    + apply (@fv_ee_open_ee_exp 0 u e1 x Hxe Hxu).
  - (* app *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* tabs *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* tapp *) discriminate Ee.
  - (* fold *) discriminate Ee.

Require Import Rules.
Require Import A4.Prelude.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Scratch-only admitted lemma (permitted by the task):          *)
(* general transitivity of subtyping.  It is NOT used to prove    *)
(* anything about the target directly; it is used only to verify  *)
(* that the candidate reduct of the counterexample is untypeable. *)
(* ============================================================ *)
Lemma sub_trans : forall E A B C,
  sub E A B -> sub E B C -> sub E A C.
Admitted.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The counterexample terms.                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition Fann : typ := typ_mu (typ_arrow typ_top typ_nat).
Definition Abod : typ := typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) typ_nat.
Definition Smu  : typ := typ_mu (typ_arrow typ_nat typ_nat).
Definition Tmu  : typ := typ_arrow typ_nat typ_nat.
Definition v0   : exp := exp_abs Fann exp_nat.

(* WF facts *)
Lemma wf_Fann : WF nil Fann.
Proof.
  unfold Fann. apply WF_rec with (L := dom nil).
  - intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow; [apply WF_top | apply WF_nat].
  - intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow; [apply WF_top | apply WF_nat].
Qed.

Lemma wf_Smu : WF nil Smu.
Proof.
  unfold Smu. apply WF_rec with (L := dom nil).
  - intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow; [apply WF_nat | apply WF_nat].
  - intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow; [apply WF_nat | apply WF_nat].
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_knot_sub : forall X, wf_env (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ nil).
Proof.
  intros X. apply wf_env_sub.
  - apply wf_env_empty.
  - apply WF_top.
  - simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_knot_typ : forall X, wf_env (X ~ bind_typ Fann ++ nil).
Proof.
  intros X. apply wf_env_typ.
  - apply wf_env_empty.
  - apply wf_Fann.
  - simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

(* sub nil (mu Abod) Fann *)
Lemma sub_muAbod_Fann : sub nil (typ_mu Abod) Fann.
Proof.
  unfold Abod, Fann. apply sa_rec with (L := dom nil).
  - (* WF of open Abod X *)
    intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow.
    + apply WF_var. simpl. left. reflexivity.
    + apply WF_nat.
  - (* WF of open (arrow top nat) X *)
    intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow; [apply WF_top | apply WF_nat].
  - (* kernel *)
    intros X _. simpl. apply sa_arrow.
    + (* sub top (label X (arrow X nat)) *)
      apply sa_top. apply WF_label.
      apply WF_arrow.
      * apply WF_var. simpl. left. reflexivity.
      * apply WF_nat.
    + (* sub nat nat *)
      apply sa_nat. apply wf_env_knot_sub.
Qed.

(* sub nil Fann Smu *)
Lemma sub_Fann_Smu : sub nil Fann Smu.
Proof.
  unfold Fann, Smu. apply sa_rec with (L := dom nil).
  - intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow; [apply WF_top | apply WF_nat].
  - intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow; [apply WF_nat | apply WF_nat].
  - intros X _. simpl. apply sa_arrow.
    + apply sa_top. apply WF_nat.
    + apply sa_nat. apply wf_env_knot_sub.
Qed.

(* sub nil Smu (mu Tmu):  Smu and (mu Tmu) are the same type *)
Lemma sub_Smu_muTmu : sub nil Smu (typ_mu Tmu).
Proof.
  unfold Smu, Tmu. apply sub_refl.
  - apply wf_env_empty.
  - apply wf_Smu.
Qed.

(* v0 : open_tt Abod Fann  (= arrow Fann nat) *)
Lemma typing_v0_open : typing nil v0 (open_tt Abod Fann).
Proof.
  unfold v0, Abod.
  change (typing nil (exp_abs Fann exp_nat) (typ_arrow Fann typ_nat)).
  apply typing_abs with (L := dom nil).
  intros X _.
  simpl. apply typing_nat. apply wf_env_knot_typ.
Qed.

(* the fold is typed at its own annotation Fann *)
Lemma typing_fold_Fann : typing nil (exp_fold Fann v0) Fann.
Proof.
  apply typing_fold with (A := Abod).
  - exact sub_muAbod_Fann.
  - exact typing_v0_open.
Qed.

(* hence the fold is typed at Smu by subsumption *)
Lemma typing_fold_Smu : typing nil (exp_fold Fann v0) Smu.
Proof.
  eapply typing_sub.
  - exact typing_fold_Fann.
  - exact sub_Fann_Smu.
Qed.

(* the whole redex is typed at  open_tt Tmu Smu = arrow nat nat *)
Lemma typing_redex : typing nil (exp_unfold Smu (exp_fold Fann v0)) (open_tt Tmu Smu).
Proof.
  change (typing nil (exp_unfold Smu (exp_fold Fann v0)) (typ_arrow typ_nat typ_nat)).
  eapply typing_unfold.
  - exact typing_fold_Smu.
  - exact sub_Smu_muTmu.
Qed.

Lemma value_v0 : value v0.
Proof.
  unfold v0. apply value_abs.
  apply expr_abs with (L := dom nil).
  - unfold Fann. apply type_mu with (L := dom nil).
    intros X _. simpl. apply type_arrow; [apply type_top | apply type_nat].
  - intros X _. simpl. apply expr_nat.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The reduct is NOT typeable at the advertised result type.          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Any typing of an abstraction exp_abs V e can be decomposed into a   *)
(* subtyping from a bare function type arrow V T1.                    *)
Lemma typing_abs_base : forall E V e T,
  typing E (exp_abs V e) T ->
  exists T1, sub E (typ_arrow V T1) T.
Proof.
  intros E V e T H.
  remember (exp_abs V e) as ex eqn:He.
  revert V e He.
  induction H; intros V0 e0 He; try discriminate He.
  - (* typing_abs *)
    injection He as HV Hee. subst.
    exists T1. apply sub_refl.
    + apply typing_wf_env in H. exact H.
    + apply WF_arrow.
      * (* WF E V *) admit.
      * (* WF E T1 *) admit.
  - (* typing_sub *)
    destruct (IHtyping V0 e0 He) as [T1 HT1].
    exists T1. eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
Admitted.

Lemma no_typing_v0 : ~ typing nil v0 (open_tt Tmu Smu).
Proof.
  unfold v0. change (~ typing nil (exp_abs Fann exp_nat) (typ_arrow typ_nat typ_nat)).
  intros H.
  destruct (typing_abs_base nil Fann exp_nat (typ_arrow typ_nat typ_nat) H)
    as [T1 Hsub].
  apply sub_arrow_inv in Hsub as [Hdom _].
  unfold Fann in Hdom.
  apply sub_nil_mu_left in Hdom.
  destruct Hdom as [F1 HF]. discriminate HF.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The counterexample: all hypotheses of fold_unfold_value hold,      *)
(* but the conclusion fails.                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem fold_unfold_value_is_false :
  typing nil (exp_fold Fann v0) Smu /\
  value v0 /\
  sub nil Smu (typ_mu Tmu) /\
  ~ typing nil v0 (open_tt Tmu Smu).
Proof.
  repeat split.
  - exact typing_fold_Smu.
  - exact value_v0.
  - exact sub_Smu_muTmu.
  - exact no_typing_v0.
Qed.

(* The stated target typing_fld_step is refuted by the same term. *)
Theorem typing_fld_step_is_false :
  exists S0 F0 v T,
    typing nil (exp_unfold S0 (exp_fold F0 v)) T /\
    ~ typing nil v T.
Proof.
  exists Smu, Fann, v0, (open_tt Tmu Smu).
  split.
  - exact typing_redex.
  - exact no_typing_v0.
Qed.

Require Import Rules.
Require Import A4.Prelude.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Scratch-only admitted lemma (permitted by the task):          *)
(* general transitivity of subtyping.  Used only to compose       *)
(* subtyping derivations in the counterexample analysis.          *)
(* ============================================================ *)
Lemma sub_trans : forall E A B C,
  sub E A B -> sub E B C -> sub E A C.
Admitted.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The counterexample terms.                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition Fann : typ := typ_mu (typ_arrow typ_top typ_nat).
Definition Abod : typ := typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) typ_nat.
Definition Smu  : typ := typ_mu (typ_arrow typ_nat typ_nat).
Definition Tmu  : typ := typ_arrow typ_nat typ_nat.
Definition v0   : exp := exp_abs Fann exp_nat.

(* WF facts *)
Lemma wf_Fann : WF nil Fann.
Proof.
  unfold Fann. apply WF_rec with (L := dom nil).
  - intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow; [apply WF_top | apply WF_nat].
  - intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow; [apply WF_top | apply WF_nat].
Qed.

Lemma wf_Smu : WF nil Smu.
Proof.
  unfold Smu. apply WF_rec with (L := dom nil).
  - intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow; [apply WF_nat | apply WF_nat].
  - intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow; [apply WF_nat | apply WF_nat].
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_knot_sub : forall X, wf_env (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ nil).
Proof.
  intros X. apply wf_env_sub.
  - apply wf_env_empty.
  - apply WF_top.
  - simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_knot_typ : forall X, wf_env (X ~ bind_typ Fann ++ nil).
Proof.
  intros X. apply wf_env_typ.
  - apply wf_env_empty.
  - apply wf_Fann.
  - simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

(* sub nil (mu Abod) Fann *)
Lemma sub_muAbod_Fann : sub nil (typ_mu Abod) Fann.
Proof.
  unfold Abod, Fann. apply sa_rec with (L := dom nil).
  - intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow.
    + apply WF_var. simpl. left. reflexivity.
    + apply WF_nat.
  - intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow; [apply WF_top | apply WF_nat].
  - intros X _. simpl. apply sa_arrow.
    + apply sa_top. apply WF_label.
      apply WF_arrow.
      * apply WF_var. simpl. left. reflexivity.
      * apply WF_nat.
    + apply sa_nat. apply wf_env_knot_sub.
Qed.

(* sub nil Fann Smu *)
Lemma sub_Fann_Smu : sub nil Fann Smu.
Proof.
  unfold Fann, Smu. apply sa_rec with (L := dom nil).
  - intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow; [apply WF_top | apply WF_nat].
  - intros X _. simpl. apply WF_arrow; [apply WF_nat | apply WF_nat].
  - intros X _. simpl. apply sa_arrow.
    + apply sa_top. apply WF_nat.
    + apply sa_nat. apply wf_env_knot_sub.
Qed.

(* sub nil Smu (mu Tmu):  Smu and (mu Tmu) are the same type *)
Lemma sub_Smu_muTmu : sub nil Smu (typ_mu Tmu).
Proof.
  unfold Smu, Tmu. apply sub_refl.
  - apply wf_env_empty.
  - apply wf_Smu.
Qed.

(* v0 : open_tt Abod Fann  (= arrow Fann nat) *)
Lemma typing_v0_open : typing nil v0 (open_tt Abod Fann).
Proof.
  unfold v0, Abod.
  change (typing nil (exp_abs Fann exp_nat) (typ_arrow Fann typ_nat)).
  apply typing_abs with (L := dom nil).
  intros X _.
  simpl. apply typing_nat. apply wf_env_knot_typ.
Qed.

(* the fold is typed at its own annotation Fann *)
Lemma typing_fold_Fann : typing nil (exp_fold Fann v0) Fann.
Proof.
  apply typing_fold with (A := Abod).
  - exact sub_muAbod_Fann.
  - exact typing_v0_open.
Qed.

(* hence the fold is typed at Smu by subsumption *)
Lemma typing_fold_Smu : typing nil (exp_fold Fann v0) Smu.
Proof.
  eapply typing_sub.
  - exact typing_fold_Fann.
  - exact sub_Fann_Smu.
Qed.

(* the whole redex is typed at  open_tt Tmu Smu = arrow nat nat *)
Lemma typing_redex : typing nil (exp_unfold Smu (exp_fold Fann v0)) (open_tt Tmu Smu).
Proof.
  change (typing nil (exp_unfold Smu (exp_fold Fann v0)) (typ_arrow typ_nat typ_nat)).
  eapply typing_unfold.
  - exact typing_fold_Smu.
  - exact sub_Smu_muTmu.
Qed.

Lemma value_v0 : value v0.
Proof.
  unfold v0. apply value_abs.
  apply expr_abs with (L := dom nil).
  - unfold Fann. apply type_mu with (L := dom nil).
    intros X _. simpl. apply type_arrow; [apply type_top | apply type_nat].
  - intros X _. simpl. apply expr_nat.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Auxiliary inversion lemmas for the reduct-untypeability proof.     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* The target of a subtyping whose source is an arrow is top or an arrow. *)
Lemma sub_arrow_target : forall E A1 A2 U,
  sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) U ->
  U = typ_top \/ (exists B1 B2, U = typ_arrow B1 B2).
Proof.
  intros E A1 A2 U H. inversion H; subst; eauto;
    try (exfalso; match goal with
         | Hr : rt_type (typ_arrow _ _) |- _ => inversion Hr
         | He : typ_arrow _ _ = typ_fvar _ |- _ => discriminate He
         | He : typ_arrow _ _ = typ_top |- _ => discriminate He
         | Hb : binds _ (bind_sub _) _ |- _ => inversion Hb
         end).
Qed.

(* Every typing of exp_abs Fann exp_nat is top or an arrow whose domain
   is a supertype of Fann. *)
Lemma typing_abs_Fann_nat_shape : forall U,
  typing nil (exp_abs Fann exp_nat) U ->
  U = typ_top \/
  (exists B1 B2, U = typ_arrow B1 B2 /\ sub nil B1 Fann).
Proof.
  intros U H.
  remember (exp_abs Fann exp_nat) as ex eqn:He.
  remember empty as E eqn:HE.
  revert He HE.
  induction H; intros He HE; try discriminate He.
  - (* typing_abs *)
    injection He as HV Hee. subst V. subst e1.
    subst E. right. exists Fann, T1. split; [reflexivity|].
    apply sub_refl.
    + apply wf_env_empty.
    + apply wf_Fann.
  - (* typing_sub *)
    destruct (IHtyping He HE) as [Htop | [B1 [B2 [HU0 HB1]]]].
    + (* inner type is top *)
      subst S. subst E. left. apply sub_top_inv in H0. exact H0.
    + (* inner type is arrow B1 B2, with B1 <: Fann *)
      destruct (sub_arrow_target E B1 B2 T H0) as [HT | [B1' [B2' HT]]].
      * subst T. left. reflexivity.
      * right. exists B1', B2'. split; [exact HT|].
        apply sub_arrow_inv in H0 as [Hdom _].
        subst E. eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma no_typing_v0 : ~ typing nil v0 (open_tt Tmu Smu).
Proof.
  unfold v0. change (~ typing nil (exp_abs Fann exp_nat) (typ_arrow typ_nat typ_nat)).
  intros H.
  destruct (typing_abs_Fann_nat_shape (typ_arrow typ_nat typ_nat) H)
    as [Htop | [B1 [B2 [Heq Hsub]]]].
  - discriminate Htop.
  - injection Heq as HB1 HB2. subst B1.
    unfold Fann in Hsub.
    apply sub_nil_mu_left in Hsub.
    destruct Hsub as [F1 HF]. discriminate HF.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The counterexample: all hypotheses of fold_unfold_value hold,      *)
(* but the conclusion fails.                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem fold_unfold_value_is_false :
  typing nil (exp_fold Fann v0) Smu /\
  value v0 /\
  sub nil Smu (typ_mu Tmu) /\
  ~ typing nil v0 (open_tt Tmu Smu).
Proof.
  repeat split.
  - exact typing_fold_Smu.
  - exact value_v0.
  - exact sub_Smu_muTmu.
  - exact no_typing_v0.
Qed.

(* The stated target typing_fld_step is refuted by the same term. *)
Theorem typing_fld_step_is_false :
  exists S0 F0 v T,
    typing nil (exp_unfold S0 (exp_fold F0 v)) T /\
    ~ typing nil v T.
Proof.
  exists Smu, Fann, v0, (open_tt Tmu Smu).
  split.
  - exact typing_redex.
  - exact no_typing_v0.
Qed.
